body:
Eugene Vindman deserves your support.
#

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-aug26?refcode=em260824-ken-burns&refcode2=1080_3892029_boRRzy&akid=1080%2E3892029%2EboRRzy)
---
Hi, it’s Ken Burns. I am coming to you with a heartfelt request:
[**If you, like me, are deeply concerned about the future of our democracy and the rising tide of extremism, I urge you to join me in supporting Eugene Vindman’s reelection campaign for Congress today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-aug26?refcode=em260824-ken-burns&refcode2=1080_3892029_boRRzy&akid=1080%2E3892029%2EboRRzy)
As a filmmaker, my life’s work has been dedicated to capturing pivotal moments in American history — moments that have shaped our nation’s identity and spirit. I’ve documented our country navigating through its darkest hours and emerging stronger and understanding the profound consequences of these moments.
Throughout my career, I’ve seen our nation evolve in countless ways, but one constant remains: our democracy, the cornerstone of our republic, and the essence of what it means to be American.
Yet, at this very moment, our democracy faces an unprecedented challenge — a critical inflection point. We are at a juncture where our very rights and freedoms are threatened.
The stakes have never been higher. Our democracy stands at a crossroads — and this moment requires leaders who will unify our country in defense of the very fabric of our nation — no matter political party or affiliation. Eugene Vindman is one of those leaders.
I first met Eugene and Alex nearly 40 years ago, when I interviewed the Vindman twins and their grandmother for a documentary about the meaning of the Statue of Liberty. It was shortly after they fled Soviet Ukraine and sought refuge in the United States as children.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-aug26?refcode=em260824-ken-burns&refcode2=1080_3892029_boRRzy&akid=1080%2E3892029%2EboRRzy)
Their father came to the U.S. with $759 in his pocket, three children, and a dream of giving them a better life. And through hard work and perseverance, they achieved just that.
Eugene’s story is the embodiment of the American dream. He is a Ukrainian immigrant, an Army Veteran, and a lifelong defender of our democracy. He’s a good man — one who has devoted himself to defending our country with courage, selflessness, and resilience, even at his own expense.
Eugene has never failed to hold our leaders accountable — no matter their party. But right now, not only is our government baselessly retaliating against him through an investigation aimed at removing him from Congress, but he is being attacked relentlessly by the far right, all because he has never failed to hold our leaders accountable.
We need to keep people like Eugene in Congress — leaders who continue to stand up for our democracy and represent the true spirit of America.
So it would mean a lot to me if you could support his reelection campaign today to help keep him fighting for us in the People’s House.
[**Can you please contribute $25 or whatever you can afford to Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress today? I am asking because it is critical.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-aug26?refcode=em260824-ken-burns&refcode2=1080_3892029_boRRzy&akid=1080%2E3892029%2EboRRzy)

#
Peter, we’re always proud of what we’ve built here.
But we’re especially proud at times like these.
On Friday, we sent an email to our membership about the pressure Hegseth and Trump are putting on the Navy to strip the aircraft carrier USS Doris Miller of its name, and replace it with Trump’s.
In the days since, nearly 21,000 of you have signed on to our petition to save the USS Doris Miller. That’s absolutely stunning, and it matters. Here’s why:
Most people in politics and the media still think the Republican Party is the party of the Military, National Security, and Veterans. It’s a fake narrative that gullible people buy into because people like Trump wrap themselves in the flag after dodging the draft six times. For twenty years VoteVets has worked to counter that narrative, because it’s bullshit.
Which party steps up every time Republicans try to gut and privatize the VA? Which party votes to support Veterans and expand their access to care over and over again while Republicans stand in the way? Which party votes to keep American Troops out of wars they should never have to fight?
And more than anything — which party is working to support and defend the Constitution today?
With Trump destroying that democracy, shredding the Constitution, building himself an arch to overshadow the graves of the fallen, and now trying to strip the USS Doris Miller of its name to replace it with his own... there’s only one answer:
The Democratic Party.
When over 20,000 of our supporters show up to stand for Doris Miller, a fallen American hero who represents the absolute best of this country, that answer becomes pretty damn clear. That’s why this matters.

Peter, we’re always proud of what we’ve built here. But we’re especially proud at times like these. Peter,
Folks, it's Conrad Cable and I've got to be honest: I am absolutely FURIOUS right now.
Want to know what's got me so upset?
Speaker Mike Johnson, while being feted at a big-money MAGA fundraiser in New York, was served a cartoonishly large and insanely expensive lobster for dinner.
---
| [](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_jaIZ8ANBLDUO7WtYBsbJgpEfDonWGYgaRFRLFcIxdRyq-fvA4fzfkP5eYmd_oZGZ21u0PWh5BV4YyI5syjs-SNj5RY9s0h2VOM1rCw6KwCS8OyPT3Vx0mhjFnTllhSnJLZVXQXziy4DGuzUSzbUeaqtkH6Np2Z4lBxJEEzL_2rMLx8xsO7at6WMnKMPWrCfdPm9RTF7FkDHaJqkGZaJ8a4ahPNePklC&c=L-elGrJS2eMohDuei7boeglG66O4Q3mdZPWm7sBiMJMiA3R43spUhQ==&ch=fC_TVpusdsVPSq-rFUuG2QtEyM468skHzIHFWyMc0PRD0V9M4xOQsg==)
---
| Listen, I like seafood as much as the next guy, but want to know why this pisses me the hell off?
Because while Johnson and his billionaire backers are munching on lobster and plotting to destroy our democracy, our Navy brothers and sisters on the USS Lincoln are being fed this absolute SLOP:
---
| [](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_jaIZ8ANBLDUO7WtYBsbJgpEfDonWGYgaRFRLFcIxdRyq-fvA4fzfkP5eYmd_oZGZ21u0PWh5BV4YyI5syjs-SNj5RY9s0h2VOM1rCw6KwCS8OyPT3Vx0mhjFnTllhSnJLZVXQXziy4DGuzUSzbUeaqtkH6Np2Z4lBxJEEzL_2rMLx8xsO7at6WMnKMPWrCfdPm9RTF7FkDDhnTlvMyuJcNk9qJCmJeb&c=L-elGrJS2eMohDuei7boeglG66O4Q3mdZPWm7sBiMJMiA3R43spUhQ==&ch=fC_TVpusdsVPSq-rFUuG2QtEyM468skHzIHFWyMc0PRD0V9M4xOQsg==)
---
Source: Reporting by USA Today
---
While Mike Johnson's donors were carving into lobster, sailors aboard the Lincoln have reported going as long as several days eating little more than half a cup of rice and two tortillas. Families say the crew has dealt with moldy showers, food shortages, and running out of basic supplies during a deployment that's now stretched past nine months.
This is what Donald Trump and Mike Johnson's war has actually cost our troops -- while the Speaker of the House dined on gigantic lobster in New York.
I'm Mike Johnson's Democratic opponent and let me tell you, Every week this war drags on, more people in this district and across the country are asking the same question: Why is Washington shipping our sailors overseas to be starved and neglected while Mike Johnson parties with billionaires?
That question is exactly why we can win this seat. Voters see his elitism and hypocrisy and they're furious about it. Come November, we have the chance to do something about it.
[I'm Conrad Cable, and I refuse to let Mike Johnson get away with this. Will you chip in $25, $10, or whatever you can afford to help me hold him accountable and take back this seat for the people he's supposed to serve -- including the sailors he's forgotten?](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_jaIZ8ANBLDUO7WtYBsbJgpEfDonWGYgaRFRLFcIxdRyq-fvA4fzfkP5eYmd_oZGZ21u0PWh5BV4YyI5syjs-SNj5RY9s0h2VOM1rCw6KwCS8OyPT3Vx0mhjFnTllhSnJLZVXQXziy4DGuzUSzbUeaqtkH6Np2Z4lBxJEEzL_2rMLx8xsO7at6WMnKMPWrCfdPm9RTF7FkCDnPzuuX-eSokVWaImlnJT&c=L-elGrJS2eMohDuei7boeglG66O4Q3mdZPWm7sBiMJMiA3R43spUhQ==&ch=fC_TVpusdsVPSq-rFUuG2QtEyM468skHzIHFWyMc0PRD0V9M4xOQsg==)

Our college experiences could hardly have looked more different. One of us was in Army ROTC, doing PT every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, with days that began before sunrise and a college experience structured around duty, discipline, and service. The other became Rush Chair for Chi Omega, immersed in a very different American college tradition built around friendship, community, and belonging.
Decades later, those experiences don't seem nearly as different as they once did.
As we help prepare our three boys, Mark, Patrick and Jack, for college, and watch Patrick's daughter Maggie navigate Clemson as both an ROTC cadet and a member of Zeta Tau Alpha, we've started to recognize a common thread. Young people need places where they belong. They need mentors who know them, peers who depend on them, standards that challenge them and opportunities to test themselves.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/29b8630c-60fd-4066-8f5b-4531953a1c40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/80bb42be-8bf8-4dd6-896d-f5c4eba0b23c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Social isolation remains a real problem on college campuses, with academic pressures, geographical relocation, technology, and social anxiety often making it harder for new students to form meaningful connections. One study says [57% of college students report feeling lonely.](https://substack.com/redirect/258fca39-8417-4c6a-ac39-4e66f18a9800?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) But we also believe college students need something that can be harder to find in a culture of nearly unlimited choice: a reason to look beyond themselves.
That is why we've found ourselves returning to a phrase that initially sounded almost playful but increasingly feels serious to us: **ROTC is the new rush.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..E3IpF5__ncN6oT43Z4X6XzxnxbfSdHhzmCUrfc4FZiY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212690812)
We don't mean that ROTC should replace fraternities or sororities. Genine's experience in Chi Omega helped shape her, and Maggie's experience at Clemson makes the case against that false choice better than we ever could. She is doing both. The more interesting question is what these institutions tell us about what young people are looking for when they arrive on campus in the first place.
Greek life has endured because the basic human desire for connection and belonging underneath it is fundamental to personal development. Hundreds of thousands of students still participate in fraternities and sororities across American higher education. Hell, there are 240,000 women nationally like Maggie that are Zeta. Social media has made recruitment more visible than ever, turning bid days, coordinated outfits and choreographed dances into content consumed far beyond individual campuses.
It is easy to look at an Instagram feed filled with sorority recruitment and see only the marketing of college life. We see something else underneath it. Young people are still searching intensely for belonging. In a generation that can connect digitally with almost anyone, anywhere, there remains enormous value in being able to say these are my people, this is my community, and this is where I am expected to show up.
At the same time, there is growing evidence that belonging by itself is not enough. Gallup reported in 2026 that [45% of Gen Z adults lack a strong sense of meaning, purpose or both](https://substack.com/redirect/868fca73-ccfd-4282-8824-a29ba78e5695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in their life. Nearly eight in ten said they wanted work centered on helping others. Young people who believed they were making a positive difference in other people's lives were substantially more likely to report meaning and purpose in their own.
We don't read those numbers as an indictment of this generation. We think they may be telling us something important about it. Young Americans have not lost their appetite for commitment. They are searching for institutions, communities and careers that feel worthy of commitment. They want to find their people, but they also want to know why what they are doing matters.
That is not a new American impulse. In fact, some of the most consequential investments in our history were built around precisely that combination of opportunity, responsibility and purpose.
In 1862, with the Civil War raging, Abraham Lincoln signed the [Morrill Act](https://substack.com/redirect/7e960823-b62c-4d76-86f3-3482b18c48f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), creating America's land-grant university system and dramatically expanding access to practical higher education. Less remembered is that military instruction was explicitly part of the model.
The idea reflected something larger about how the country understood education. America needed engineers, farmers, scientists and teachers who could build the nation, but also citizens prepared to lead their communities and, when necessary, defend it. Education was not simply preparation for employment. It was part of the infrastructure of citizenship.
Congress expanded that idea in 1916 when the National Defense Act formally established the Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC). Rather than relying exclusively on the service academies to develop officers, America created a leadership pipeline across civilian colleges and universities.
Future officers would study alongside future physicians, engineers, teachers, and business leaders earning civilian degrees while preparing for military service. Leadership development would become part of the broader American college experience.
More than a century later, ROTC remains the largest single source of commissioned officers for the U.S. military, producing more than 8,500 officers annually. Army ROTC alone has commissioned more than 600,000 men and women over its history. Its alumni have gone on to become chairmen of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Cabinet secretaries, senior business leaders, physicians, educators, astronauts and public servants.
The institution has evolved alongside the country it serves. Women now represent a significant share of ROTC participation across the services. Maggie is part of that evolution. At Clemson, she can pursue her degree, be a Zeta, enjoy football Saturdays (unless it's a field training weekend) and everything else that makes college memorable while simultaneously preparing herself for the responsibility of military leadership.
What interests us isn't simply the uniform. It is the model underneath it. ROTC invests in the whole person. Cadets earn the same degrees as their classmates while developing capabilities that do not appear neatly on a transcript. They maintain physical standards, take on increasing responsibility, learn to lead and follow, recover from mistakes and operate within a team where other people depend on them.
Patrick knows what that kind of formation can mean because he experienced an intensive version of it at King's College Army ROTC and later as a professor at West Point. The crucible of balancing military training taught lessons no classroom could have replicated. Discipline became less about following rules than developing the habit of doing what was required even when you didn't feel like doing it. Leadership meant being accountable for other people's welfare and performance, not simply being the person in charge. Purpose came from understanding that your decisions affected people beyond yourself.
In an age of almost unlimited choice, that can be powerful.
College has traditionally been the moment when young Americans encounter extraordinary freedom. That freedom is valuable. It gives students room to experiment, discover new interests, change their minds and become independent adults. But freedom without any structure can also become drift. A student can spend four years accumulating credits, experiences and credentials without ever being seriously responsible for anyone other than himself or herself.
ROTC provides a counterweight. There is somewhere to be at 0550 in the morning. There are physical standards to meet. There are teammates counting on you. There are mentors paying attention to whether you are improving. Eventually, there are people you will be responsible for leading.
Those obligations can look restrictive from the outside. For the right young person, they can be liberating. Purpose often begins when someone else is counting on you.
There is another reason ROTC deserves a fresh look, and it may be the most practical one for families staring at the cost of college: the economics.
For decades, Americans were encouraged to think of higher education as an almost automatic investment. Earn the degree, take on debt if necessary, and trust that higher lifetime earnings would justify the cost. For many families, that bargain has become harder to accept without question. College is getting more and more expensive - Patrick is still paying his off and the average debt is $32K+. Student debt follows millions of Americans well into adulthood. At the same time, technological disruption is making the future value of some credentials harder to predict.
For students who qualify and are prepared to accept the accompanying four year active duty or eight year reserve service obligation, ROTC offers a fundamentally different proposition. Scholarships and education benefits can substantially reduce the cost of earning a college degree. Cadets can graduate with an accredited education, several years of structured leadership development, a professional network and a defined first career as a commissioned officer, which makes up about 12% of our troops.
No student should join ROTC simply to avoid college debt. A commission carries a real obligation to serve, leading America's sons and daughters in uniform, and that obligation should be understood clearly before anyone signs up. But for students already drawn to service, the economics deserve serious attention. ROTC connects things that modern higher education too often treats separately: what you learn, how you develop, what it costs and what you are prepared to do when you graduate.
That distinction may become considerably more important in the age of artificial intelligence.
AI will make knowledge cheaper and more accessible. It will write software, analyze data, summarize documents, perform research and automate tasks that once required years of specialized training. No one can say with confidence what the labor market will look like when today's freshmen are forty, or even thirty.
We can be more confident about what will remain scarce.
Judgment, integrity, resilience, courage, empathy and the ability to earn trust do not become less valuable because information becomes abundant. The ability to bring people with different backgrounds together, make decisions with incomplete information, accept responsibility when something goes wrong and persuade others to work toward a common objective may become more valuable precisely because so much else can be automated.
We often call these "soft skills." There is nothing soft about them. They are among the hardest capabilities to develop and among the most consequential when a company, a community or a country is under pressure.
This is where the contemporary search for purpose becomes especially interesting.
We don't believe today's students have lost their appetite for commitment. The continuing pull of fraternities, sororities, athletics, faith communities and other campus organizations suggests the opposite. Young people still want to belong. Research showing their desire for meaningful work suggests that belonging alone may not be enough. They also want significance, a sense that what they do matters to someone beyond themselves.
That is what makes ROTC feel unexpectedly modern.
Maggie's experience has made that tangible for us. As both an ROTC cadet and a member of Zeta Tau Alpha at Clemson, she is living the "and," not the "or." Her sorority offers friendship, tradition, service and community. ROTC asks her to develop another dimension of herself through discipline, preparation, leadership and an obligation to serve. Together, those experiences demonstrate something that can get lost in the debate over the purpose of college: students don't have to choose between belonging and purpose. The most formative college experience may come from finding both.
Our high school junior sons Mark, Patrick and Jack will ultimately make their own choices, as they should. We aren't trying to determine their professions before they've chosen their majors, and we don't assume military service is right for every young person. Our role as parents together isn't to engineer their outcomes. It is to help create the conditions in which they can become the best versions of themselves.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a72fb82a-da52-4e46-9bb8-a630ca4b97e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

That means encouraging them toward environments that demand something of them, mentors who will challenge them and communities where people notice when they don't show up. It means encouraging them to accept responsibility before they feel completely ready for it and to understand leadership not as another credential for a resume, but as an obligation to other people. Whether they eventually become entrepreneurs, engineers, physicians, tradesmen, business leaders, public servants or military officers matters less to us than whether they become men whom other people can trust.
For generations, rush has helped students answer one of the first questions they encounter when they arrive on campus: Where do I belong? That question isn't going away. If anything, in an increasingly digital and fragmented culture, belonging may matter more than ever. But another question is becoming just as important: What am I willing to commit myself to?
For our family, that is where ROTC enters the conversation. It offers community while asking something in return. It offers educational opportunities while attaching responsibility to it. It develops leadership not as an abstract concept but through the daily experience of being accountable to other people. It can offer a pathway through college with less financial burden, but only in exchange for the very real commitment of service afterward.
That combination of belonging and obligation, opportunity and responsibility, is not new. It is a very old American idea. What feels new is how relevant it has become again.
Perhaps the great challenge for this generation isn't that young people lack ambition. Perhaps it is helping them connect that ambition to something larger than themselves. The evidence suggests they are already looking for it. Our responsibility, as parents and as a country, is to make sure the institutions that offer it remain visible, accessible and valued.
For more than a century, ROTC has been one of those institutions. In an age searching again for community, leadership and purpose, it deserves another look.
ROTC is the new rush.

Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026

Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

We're not sitting around waiting on November and hoping everything falls our way. Our teams are already on the ground in these three states, doing the actual work. Knocking doors. Registering voters. Chasing down every conservative ballot until it's counted. Clipboard and tennis shoes work, the kind that doesn't trend online but wins elections. We proved this model in 2024. We ran the most sophisticated ballot-chasing operation the Right has ever put together, and we won every single state where we ran it. 10 for 10. Now we're doing it again, in the three states that decide everything this time. ${Recipient.FirstName}, this is how you can help us win this November. **Every dollar you send fuels the machine we're building in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire right now. More volunteers in the field. More doors knocked. More voters registered. More ballots chased before Election Day.** [**Chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can today. **DONATE NOW**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcGO3CAMhp-G3DJKMAFy4FBplJ62XfXSIzLgmaCSkAIzq759le08Qa_-7U-f7Z9v9g1jivv9G25k7vk4bKl2pUL1Y8VWC2FKf_LeVkpxJ8sHLvtB93yy6Ft8khXYBSNQCillR2ZUWkkJCoZuNeCBuJrGQE5NWrvBOaW1w1l45wh5F80JHDSfRhgnLi5yllregnOKuzEIYGKgEFsul9OtUI2B9hYxXXzeumTW1o7K4AvjC-NLJf8odMGdQm5nB-NLO07RvDO-TMKRvjnROzfxXgxE_Rw09DfyAmaaYVQzg6XmR_FkfQ7E4Pr1-_v7jxFGIRXj8tE2u1GIj43BlTaM6VX8N8TgumIJWH9Z9L9fkcftwHjfGVzbgZ8ntL49X2mjcrK6YsLxEVOKVSomhvvJ_lyy_e9bnob_DQAA___d35z4)

This is a grassroots fight, won door by door. We just need the resources to keep our people out there.

Don't sit this one out, Friend. Every day between now and the midterms counts.

Joining Steve is Dr. Jessica Rose, PhD, MSc, BSc, is a Senior Fellow specializing in Computational Biology from Canada. She holds a Bachelor's Degree in applied mathematics and a master's degree in Immunology from Memorial University of Newfoundland, and a PhD in Computational Biology from Bar Ilan University. Dr. Rose has completed two post-doctoral degrees in Molecular Biology from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, and in Biochemistry from the Technion Institute of Technology. She is best known for her contributions to public health and safety related to the COVID-19 injectable products, and her analyses of pharmacovigilance databases like VAERS. For more info go to

As Senate majority leader, I don't reach out like this often. But the next 100 days demand it. |
Peter,

I am reaching out to you personally, and I want you to know I don't do this lightly.

As Senate Majority Leader, I am responsible for protecting every single seat in this chamber. I know the battlefield. I see the polls, the internal data, the fundraising numbers on both sides.

**_[And I am telling you directly: We have less than 100 days, and this majority is not safe.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=ad6bf7039d2f44149af93d9304550735&_e=OAf5AToF7TBVvo4ZMa6w5ZHdpmF_oGIj3g80FFASMWc8Emfm9PxsPluseJK-ahDcMS7r8dWXsCh0zi5GAdOwsvXvKm492rg6ZLCt17T2PYZEJDs4FmiYkTUrhddCpXxXv-QV5rmEs1ucj2bn31fmTlOi3a3RGdn5TubPjGUEhCkfaH4Z1y-FVL7wtp0zdy71tV9CH3IhZojsvxUXJh6w2xiAaQa7--jniyxBaM4y3X81oIB5J_AXL10hINcv5FKdfk2jE8s3ywYO6WVdea4PxC2c2BsVDnqF7YVg_NJpAXcJ0A61xE5JRPSZDb_ZGPRltNX0DYJ-BfPG489Gtj4VVcaQabQfuRdZ7pEd-rr1ApbxqgBGyKI8s-uIfdX54K7EyjtHRR2E-Few27PF0DuDrhfBSrS6XDkbQyfdH3LTZ_r-_c0HzyQ3XhqYaGfOkn_2eucDBaw5RRGXurAbLtlnHtanrXC2H7PZNTddh8XcsSbDkv_NyuqFzB8E4LmjaRxRw_OXV0Toz6bFS6-HwODZfZcwthvStYj01Vw6Fe-l96SiRi-_Tlw5mW_mM9gbRiIA6ecOJ-xkCkujKUJcqmXpF5E7MhujdrRiIxX7fDwhafIvKVreJzlvQ-Klo22R3TWn_mxHVxfVqC2VlA75SBQ4Od1zYaX1NLPLOXDEkPSHFtMoQKGfNUw16OwCxo0jyMgazxQNKCWnuwT4qxmen5xjI22iH3vMqCtckp8M43t7fOwRxxDI9Ume2e2TQhk3Ug3Ixkg3fSKjmgrDH1nG8earzj5fnerw-7bLpTf-cGg7Ci173FWoCYjvbEtRPSNQHfpLTtOhBbi5USH-pBbEgaMGmjGAcMkqP3Jr5SESjhLXr35qyHYNpLaU_ta9yEoEs_y2emHEq5GldZh4k8IT740xMTNEIiWcQCITq3azBobEcowPerCPEKnDZ_cBb6rJBBzH--ZcjfOq-yi4hT40zWNY5ftfCrD2tIIlvBwwv-zsz6jPpVY6aWlRs9xSHcsltPHHKpT9G8kktJ0Yytv1HS7xbq-ipOio6AJPG3RqkwBrS8j1CCpuZX1SBdT_YzR02_jQ9BHUO3Xk-zOh75iUyGWq9iXvT4kurWorVBwv4nojiDQ%3D)_**

The New York Times is calling it a coin flip. Our internal numbers tell a more complicated story. We are holding in most places, but the margin for error is razor thin, and Chuck Schumer knows it. He has been working toward this moment since the night of the 2024 elections.

**Here is what I need you to understand about what 's at stake:**

If Democrats flip the Senate, my gavel goes to Chuck Schumer. And on day one, everything changes.

clean_body: As Senate majority leader, I don't reach out like this often. But the next 100 days demand it. | Peter, I am reaching out to you personally, and I want you to know I don't do this lightly. As Senate Majority Leader, I am responsible for protecting every single seat in this chamber. I know the battlefield. I see the polls, the internal data, the fundraising numbers on both sides. The New York Times is calling it a coin flip. Our internal numbers tell a more complicated story. We are holding in most places, but the margin for error is razor thin, and Chuck Schumer knows it. He has been working toward this moment since the night of the 2024 elections. Here is what I need you to understand about what 's at stake: If Democrats flip the Senate, my gavel goes to Chuck Schumer. And on day one, everything changes. Every bill that comes from the House, the border security measures, the spending cuts, the legislation that protects the Trump agenda, dies in a Democrat-controlled Senate. We fight defensive battles instead of setting the agenda. I have spent my career building toward this moment. A Republican Senate. A conservative agenda. A majority that can actually deliver results for the American people. I am not going to let it slip away in the next 100 days because we didn 't do the work when it mattered. Welcome to our interactive grassroots newsletter. As we approach the Midterm Election 2026, this newsletter is dedicated to keeping the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District informed and engaged.

Our campaign is built on a "district-first" mentality. We are committed to prioritizing your needs, focusing on fundamental ideals of sensible solutions and open dialogue. Through this newsletter, we will provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district.
Click the button below to make a donation today. Your donations are what makes this possible.

District-First Events.

---
| |

| | | | | | | | | | | |
# Kitchen Table Tuesday
---
| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.
---
| | |
---
| | As your representative, I am committed to defending the fundamental principle of Fair Play in Women's Sports. For decades, female athletes have worked tirelessly to achieve equality, making it a matter of protecting the important rights owed to women under Title IX. We must guarantee that these hard-won opportunities are preserved, which is why I firmly believe that women athletes deserve to **compete on a fair playing field.**
.To safeguard these opportunities, my goal in Congress is to **support the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act** to prevent biological males from competing in female athletics. This crucial legislation will provide positive protections and ensure that the integrity of women's sports is maintained. By standing up for this act, we can guarantee that every young woman in our district has the chance to compete, excel, and be recognized fairly for her dedication and hard work.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | The Devastating Impact of Job Losses and How We Must Respond
.According to a recent Chicago Tribune article, Tyson Foods announced the devastating closure of its beef processing facility in Joslin, Illinois. This massive shutdown—spurred by nationwide cattle shortages and mounting industry losses—will result in the **termination of approximately 2,500 local workers** and send a massive economic shockwave throughout the state's agricultural and manufacturing sectors. The loss of these jobs highlights the terrible toll that a fragile economy and a hostile business environment can have on hardworking Illinois families who rely on steady employment to survive.
.While families across the state are losing jobs and struggling to get by, Democrat incumbents like Sean Casten have failed the hardworking people of Illinois. Sean Casten is inept for the job he currently holds, pushing for increased spending on nonessential programs that benefit people in foreign countries while forgetting about hardworking American families. Instead of focusing on policies that benefit everyday citizens, **Casten is more concerned with his own political survival by satisfying the radical elements of his party.** His failures to rein in wasteful spending have even earned him the "Big Spender" designation by the National Taxpayers Union. Under this failed leadership, everyday Americans are forced to deplete their savings just to get by.
.Niki Conforti understands that we are working harder for less and has a clear plan to help the residents of the 6th Congressional District. **Niki plans to take direct action** to provide relief and create jobs by focusing on initiatives like:
.
* **Stimulating Economic Growth:** Passing legislation to stimulate economic growth and business activity. Niki will work to stimulate the return of manufacturing to the 6th District to get people back to work.
* **Expanding Job Training:** Expanding workforce training programs. Aiming to help connect hard-working Illinoisans with good paying jobs.
* **Stopping Tax Hikes:** Niki opposes tax and fee hikes on Illinoisans. She will work to curb the spending in Washington and stop tax increases on working families.
* **Lowering Costs:** Pushing for legislation that cuts regulations in the energy industry. This will make energy more resilient and more affordable for local households and local businesses.
.

We cannot afford to let Illinois continue losing industry and jobs at a quickening pace. It is **time for a representative who puts the district first** and fights for policies that support our workforce and protect our wallets.
.
Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/GWendJhm4PR?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)

| |

| | **Join the Conforti Campaign at the 2026 Autumn In The Park Festival!
**.We warmly invite you to participate and walk alongside Niki Conforti and our campaign team at the **Palos Park Autumn In The Park Festival Parade!** Come out to show your support for our "District-First" vision and join the community for this wonderful tradition.

* **Date:** Saturday, September 19, 2026
* **Time:** The parade steps off at 1:00 PM.
* **Location/Route:** The parade kicks off at 83rd Avenue on 123rd Street in Palos Park and travels westbound to 90th Avenue ending near the festival grounds.
* **Post-Parade:** A lively festival will be running from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM on the Village Green (8901 W. 123rd St). The festival will feature food vendors, artisan vendors, kids activities, and live musical entertainment!
.

We would love to have you join our ranks for this special day! To get more details, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com.**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Event%3A%202026%20Autumn%20In%20The%20Park%20Festival&body=)

We look forward to seeing you there!.
.
.
**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (DuPage County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot:**August 5th**
* Early voting and vote-by-mail voting begins: **September 24th**
* Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot: **October 29th**
* Last day for early voting: **November 2nd**
* General Election Day:**November 3rd**
.

**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (Cook County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: **August 5th**
* First day to vote early in Chicago (Downtown Only): **September 24th** Last day for online voter registration: **October 18th**
* Early voting opens in all 50 city wards and suburban Cook County: **October 19th**
* Deadline for vote-by-mail applications: **October 29th**
* General Election Day: **November 3rd**
.

**Get out the vote:** whether you plan to vote by mail, early voting in person, or voting in person on election day, it’s important we get out the vote to defeat incumbent Sean Casten.

Peter Willis,

One of our organizers recently called a Michigan voter who had been told

Our organizer explained that under Michigan law, he could vote. The man

Peggy Flanagan in Minnesota.
Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan.
Charles Booker in Kentucky.

Angie Nixon in Florida.

undecided but deeply worried about skyrocketing healthcare costs.

Peter -
My name is Mary Peltola, and after winning our open primary, I am officially running in the general election for United States Senate in Alaska.
I want to share with you why I made the decision to run – and to ask for your support as we begin the general election together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to join our fight for fish, family, and freedom, please use this button to split a contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate and Heartland Patriots:

Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us.
They're focused on their own wallets – not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
**This is going to be the closest and most consequential Senate race this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together.**
So I am asking:

## **News from the Campaign Trail**
---
**Call and Demand a Debate : Update**Thank you to those who called to demand Congressman Lloyd Smucker hold a public debate with Nancy! Correction: please call Smucker’s campaign office, not his congressional office, to make this request. The campaign office number is 717-394-4165.
---
| | | | Help us get our message to every person in PA-11
by making your donation today!
---|---
| [ DONATE TODAY ](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEag4ErLzpEhPxLt9QUXR/5hpHi4MRbNSz)
---

**We’re Building a Win One Door at a Time – Join Us!** Our door knocking outreach is off to a strong start, and every conversation is helping us build the people-powered campaign Nancy needs to win. We are working closely with the “Coordinated Campaign” which is funded by the PA Dems to support the Governor and Lt. Governor’s re-elections, as well as with our other state candidates and representatives and local Democratic groups. Together, the campaign teams have already knocked on thousands of doors across Lancaster and York Counties.
Volunteers are currently focused on reaching infrequent Democrat, Independent, and persuadable Republican voters before shifting into full “Get Out The Vote” mode in the final weeks before the election.
What we are hearing at the doors is energizing! Voters are frustrated with the direction of the country and disappointed by Republican incumbents. Some voters are considering sitting this election out while others are open to new choices. One recent conversation with a Libertarian couple who had voted for Donald Trump three times showed just how much people are reconsidering: they felt misled after losing access to electric vehicle tax credits they had planned to use for a new American-made vehicle.
If you have never knocked on doors before, this is a great time to try. Fear is probably the reason most people don’t volunteer. But consider this: What’s worse – hearing a stranger who you may never see again say ‘no’ to you or having Donald Trump as president without Congress to check his power? You do not have to be an expert on policy – you just need to show up, listen, share why this race matters to you personally, and help voters connect the issues they care about to the choices in front of them.
New volunteers receive a brief training, and first timers can walk with an experienced volunteer. The best moments often start with a simple doorstep conversation. Whether someone is worried about prices, accountability in Congress, respect for service members and their families, or government overreach, volunteers are helping voters feel heard—and helping them see Nancy as the alternative they have been waiting for.
**Ready to get involved?** We are adding new opportunities regularly, with the goal of having something happening every day through Election Day. On our campaign’s [Mobilize](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30mRHkLv9rg1BGyPEFV/27by5fTGhPwA) page you will find canvass launches near you, get updates, and join the next wave of volunteers talking to voters one door at a time.
**Want to organize your own outreach in your own neighborhood?** [Contact our team](mailto:mailto:Info@nancymannion.co) and we’ll give you everything you need to get started.
---
---
| ✉️ Enjoying These Campaign Updates? Help us grow our community by forwarding this email to friends, family, and neighbors. **Was this email forwarded to you?** Sign up to receive Nancy's campaign updates directly in your inbox. | [ Sign Up for Weekly Updates → ](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFVLUdi8i151w50enNxxZ/hlp1kBII9fii)
---
### **Week in Review:**
---
**York County Farm Bureau Tour of Godfrey Bros.** On Thursday, August 18, Nancy joined local leaders for the York County Farm Bureau legislative tour at Godfrey Bros. Meats near Loganville. The family-owned business, operating since the 1930s, is known for selling high-quality meats raised without hormones or antibiotics. Attendees toured the facility and received updates on state and federal issues affecting York County farmers.
In a related announcement this past week, President Trump plans to import hundreds of millions of pounds of foreign beef into the U.S. in an effort to lower consumer prices. According to a recent Facebook post by the Pennsylvania Farm Bureau that featured Bureau President Tommy Nagle, “...Continuing to increase the amount of foreign-raised beef to fix prices at the grocery store will wipe out progress that American farmers have made and make us more reliant on foreign countries, weaking our national food security in the long term...”
Lancaster and York Counties have the highest and second-highest numbers of farms in Pennsylvania – farms that raise the livestock that is sent to local processors such as Godfrey Bros. Encourage friends and family to buy from local processors and markets that support our farmers and strengthen businesses across our district.

---
| | |
### **Want to meet or support Nancy?**
---
| **Check out the opportunities below:**

* **Elizabethtown Fair – Tuesday, August 25, 4:00 – 8:00pm and Friday, August 28, 5:00**–** 9:00pm.****** Nancy will be volunteering at the Elizabethtown Democratic Committee table. Elizabethtown Fairgrounds, 900 East High Street.
* **Meet & Greet Candidates hosted by the Penn Manor Democrats at Margaritas in the ‘Ville – Saturday, August 29, 1:00 – 4:00pm, Phantom Power, 121 W. Frederick St, Millersville.** More info [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFxgCq8X470CC8q2cMhfd/-r-32aA-OKqO).
* **Meet & Greet Candidates with Garden Spot Democrats – Sunday, August 30, 1:00pm – 3:00pm**, Hart Pavillon at New Holland Community Park, 400 East Jackson Street, New Holland. Meet Nancy, PA Senator James Malone as well as candidates Ethan Gabrick, Bryan Peirson, and Dale Hamby.
* **Hanover Town Hall with Nancy Mannion – Tuesday, September 1, 7:00pm – 8:30pm.** More info [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGQ0v2YvQCvMSCfQRLRNh/4hVCh9J0JHsK).
* **Join Mobilize to Support Nancy’s Campaign** \- We will be adding door knocking sessions regularly. To stay updated on volunteer opportunities, sign up [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGsLdEzJmIqWiGUoGKB5l/b8VvTgbK1G2S) for Mobilize—our online platform for campaign event notifications. You’ll receive updates about our weekly outreach events as we get out the vote!
* **Signs, Signs, Everywhere a Sign** \- [Click here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsHKgLRPi8OlgyKKC5Iunp/w9OHVIw8T_HU) to reserve one now and a volunteer will deliver one to you or coordinate a pick-up.

| | | | | | Hello Peter,

I’d love to see you in West Chester tonight!
Please join us for **From Conversation to Congress: A Meet & Greet Reception** — an opportunity to come together, talk about the issues affecting our communities, and discuss the kind of leadership we need in Washington.

### FROM CONVERSATION TO CONGRESS
###
**Meet & Greet Reception with Dr. Vanessa Enoch**📅 **Tuesday, August 25, 2026**
⏰ **6:30 PM – 8:00 PM**
📍 **Hummus & Pita**
7334 Tylers Corner Dr.
West Chester, OH 45069
This campaign is about more than winning an election. It is about listening to people across Ohio’s 8th Congressional District and turning those conversations into **real solutions and real impact**.
I want to hear from you.
What issues are affecting your family? What concerns do you have about our community and our country? What should Congress be doing differently?Come meet me, bring your questions and ideas, and learn more about our vision for building a stronger future for the people of Ohio’s 8th District.

### RSVP TODAY. Come today!
**RSVP here:**
[ https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hummusandpita](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=afda2b6358&e=c6e7dff14c)
And please bring a friend, neighbor, colleague, or family member. The more people we bring into the conversation, the stronger our movement becomes.
**Your Voice. Your District. Your Campaign.**
I hope to see you tomorrow evening!
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Congress
Ohio’s 8th Congressional District

name: Deb Haaland
subject: It’s time to Be Fierce
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
No one can Be Fierce alone.

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=11970%2E400544%2Eub5h_m)
---
Friend, it’s Deb Haaland, and I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico. **_[Will you donate $5 right now to fuel my general election campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15424?refcode=jtk1261-fr-nd&t=2&akid=11970%2E400544%2Eub5h_m)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1261-fr-nd&t=3&akid=11970%2E400544%2Eub5h_m)
---
You may have noticed it throughout this campaign, how I sign my emails, what I say on TV, and how I talk with voters. I always come back to the same saying: Be Fierce.

Be Fierce in how we show up for our families. Be Fierce in how we fight for working people. Be Fierce when powerful interests try to tell us what’s possible and what isn’t.

It’s a reminder to push forward and break ceilings, like I did as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and later as the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history — and because of what we’re doing together right now, when we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state.
Being Fierce is also a commitment to never back down. I learned that in Congress when I stopped Donald Trump from threatening our public lands and our communities, and again at the Department of the Interior when I rebuilt after cuts, rollbacks, and attacks on conservation and working families.

**And now, when healthcare is gutted, costs go up, and the affordability crisis is ignored, I won’t back down, I will Be Fierce. I will fight for working families across New Mexico and deliver real results, not excuses, and I will be sure to leave the ladder down for the next generation.**
But, friend, no one can Be Fierce alone. This race is already one of the most competitive in the country. Republicans are preparing to spend whatever it takes to flip New Mexico, and we can’t afford to slow down now. **_[Will you chip in $5 or anything you can to my campaign right now to help power this movement to November and Be Fierce in this fight?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15424?refcode=jtk1261-fr-nd&t=4&akid=11970%2E400544%2Eub5h_m)_**

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

I want to start with two simple words.

Thank you.

Thank you for caring about children you may never meet.

Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold.

Because that is exactly what is happening.

Every day.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8n8cWbsLAfAtCGa_n0LM0Xrk_puyUGN7t7m9i0OpgP9Aw600AieuEQUoQfNyzhLXhnYsayiPvPFuzvRrwUeQABB2d6e6Fr5Edoog

God's children are not for sale.

And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth.

When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8oXn_gwEW3Cbd4L8_V1RLooX19_Sz_djvzAXn6iXrXInKczecTROSyufPvaA7rIkUEHZ4YtJL7DnPU22RJD8epHR494MddDbVgFg

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8pL9yLtVCu51Zi2qKFu5pXvLeZ2Q_xTjCce-ULAfW_HfmXTdiZtwtc69l20ADzUwTAWgnIe9x2D80xwYPt1NI31k5poXkEYyWdHg

This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store.

You can't buy it online.

It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say:

"No more."

Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters.

A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity.

And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see.

Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself.

A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children.

Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission.

Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8qsu0_rr-OvVLM4dQ-G0_XWzX29DLdlFQkFACKEpJR2PgQQKAWFxByRdNnDSXB0oPGuhkMP4IoM2pDBTQdzrsGY_s32fZs1BRgZw
Protect God's Children Today

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui.

Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart.

Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed.

I couldn't forget it.

I couldn't stay silent.

I kept asking myself one question:

"What if it were my child?"

That question changed my life.

What started as a film project became a mission and a calling.

That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom.

Not for fame.
Not for awards.
But because I believed people needed to see the truth.

For years, many people said the film would never succeed.

Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up.

But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.

And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough.

That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

Our mission is simple:

To stop the sale of God's children.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8rglV_NYUxewRcTlXHjLqWQslCFsPYhfGQbiGI8olEWxeMyRESCy6qvFy5iKXG5cVZ5pvS892dmGUeSm3WLgtskSWTXQ50uc1zgw
Protect God's Children Today

Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear.

And every day, we work to fight back.

Jesus said,

"Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14)

Every child is precious in God's eyes.

Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth.

And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8sKvetWU6mQcgYuc65MEnCyJCeQN0NbVTt8-JXrv7joZhcN0rybv5IWDYmmfbDSiD9J0BLZK8p6N1noA7V2GHQ3iRric9fuRoB4Q

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8topip33tWBYq0QkJs_3j_XvmM__qzrNw2AJBn3RwUftyjWPbasO7BuiV6FhUk5A_IoafDjAgyyA9sRPMpjwQVriGbbOY4V_DQ-A
Protect God's Children Today

When you make your first gift today, you help:

- Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children.

- Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation.

- Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children.

- Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis.

- Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers.

This is how change happens.

One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.

Today, that person can be you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8uHiD6KyQ-jkgJBt6slFvtqM-7iOZov9LRy0cWg0XXyhXNGmbM0LhBF2kQWFU0rKnfX1CkmGVusaittQw3RTLlKrS_Uz63FBn8Ag
Protect God's Children Today

Will you make your first gift now?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9AAwAAAAAAo5AHR8vWASeRUmD8ToqQrMMRG59mSyFXSK8zq_XQ6C0WcYgVHCm4y6lR89mjLREy5E05dJmbHyTI4RBV-vlP7MEqbXbX5FLX95N2I2PGg
Please make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can today to help protect vulnerable children from exploitation and trafficking.

Choose your shirt size and select a color.

And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most.

Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children.

Thank you for choosing action over silence.

With gratitude and prayer,

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Their attacks don’t faze me one bit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by DLCC PAC
body:
| | |
---
| |
---|---
Donald Trump, Mike Rogers’ team, and MAGA Republicans have started using my full name — Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed — like it's a weapon. Like the extra syllables are supposed to make you trust me less. I think that says more about them than it does about me. **That’s because when you don't have a record to run on, you run on fear instead.** Mike Rogers voted to raise his own pay, took over a million dollars from opioid makers and Wall Street banks, and cashed in for millions the moment he left Congress. I've spent my whole life being relatively young, relatively brown, and relatively Muslim. It can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching online for abortion pills.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGK3DAMhp_Guc3gyI7jPeSwNKS9bNmWQo9BoyiJWccxtjN9_ZIyA73u8f_18YGk32_jGzrvwvIdN-5SmceUx5V9PHJipHXlNLuUywgSzEXaCzQjUnF3HjVWUzfRhDVV3NWtbY2xALpau3q2OMlGWzPxzGzZaEUkNSEYPBHXnT5poam1krW90q1BbWZqqeEXoEloiZ5TuSaOx807wlAwf8x7Ir7SvlW-W0uJWahXAYOAYXF3F5ZrTHzbUzgRAcMjCRhoZfrYjyJgQIqrtGC8UEMWqn_98v7tzF_fBRjCLaJbglC9VvDSKgHmKNuY9yMRC9XHtOfIVFxYHqONJ3dsQvW8ofOP8j_PnfKz3EPhUITqf7SXn7-Gy_MIVeqm-Md577JphZbLafq3Zvn0T-4d_A0AAP__-52Zlg)

Dear Friend of Life, **It can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching online for abortion pills.** That should stop us in our tracks. Imagine a woman who has just discovered she is pregnant. She wasn’t expecting this. She may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or how she could possibly have this baby. She is frightened, overwhelmed, and looking for someone to tell her what to do next. So she reaches for her phone. Within moments, she can find an abortion provider ready to sell her pills that will end her pregnancy and the life of her baby—all without ever walking into an abortion facility. **But what if she found hope instead?** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our Network Clinics across America provide free ultrasounds to women facing unexpected pregnancies. When a mother has the opportunity to see her baby and hear the heartbeat, what once felt like an impossible situation can suddenly look very different. But the way women are making decisions about abortion has changed. **Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills.** Today, we cannot simply wait and hope a frightened mother walks through the doors of a pregnancy clinic. If women are going online looking for abortion, **we have to reach them there—and we have to reach them first.** That is why PreBorn! is expanding our reach through our Virtual Care System. Through this innovative approach, we can reach women while they are looking online for answers and create an opportunity for them to connect with something profoundly different from the abortion industry: **A real person who cares about her and her baby.** A registered nurse can listen to what she is facing without judgment, answer her questions, provide pregnancy education, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound and continued support. And when welcomed, our nurses can pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. Friend of Life, think about the difference. The abortion industry is prepared to meet a frightened woman online and sell her pills to end the life of her baby. [**PreBorn! wants to meet her with a compassionate human being who will slow down, listen to what she is facing, and help her discover another path forward with her baby.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGK3DAMhp_Guc3gyI7jPeSwNKS9bNmWQo9BoyiJWccxtjN9_ZIyA73u8f_18YGk32_jGzrvwvIdN-5SmceUx5V9PHJipHXlNLuUywgSzEXaCzQjUnF3HjVWUzfRhDVV3NWtbY2xALpau3q2OMlGWzPxzGzZaEUkNSEYPBHXnT5poam1krW90q1BbWZqqeEXoEloiZ5TuSaOx807wlAwf8x7Ir7SvlW-W0uJWahXAYOAYXF3F5ZrTHzbUzgRAcMjCRhoZfrYjyJgQIqrtGC8UEMWqn_98v7tzF_fBRjCLaJbglC9VvDSKgHmKNuY9yMRC9XHtOfIVFxYHqONJ3dsQvW8ofOP8j_PnfKz3EPhUITqf7SXn7-Gy_MIVeqm-Md577JphZbLafq3Zvn0T-4d_A0AAP__-52Zlg) That is the opportunity your generosity can help put in front of her. Right now, **our goal is to reach 500 women facing unexpected pregnancies by August 31** and give them the opportunity to connect with compassionate, life-affirming care before abortion becomes their answer. Will you help us reach them?

That should stop us in our tracks. Imagine a woman who has just discovered she is pregnant. She wasn’t expecting this. She may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or how she could possibly have this baby. She is frightened, overwhelmed, and looking for someone to tell her what to do next. So she reaches for her phone. Within moments, she can find an abortion provider ready to sell her pills that will end her pregnancy and the life of her baby—all without ever walking into an abortion facility. But what if she found hope instead? PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our Network Clinics across America provide free ultrasounds to women facing unexpected pregnancies. When a mother has the opportunity to see her baby and hear the heartbeat, what once felt like an impossible situation can suddenly look very different. But the way women are making decisions about abortion has changed. Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills. Today, we cannot simply wait and hope a frightened mother walks through the doors of a pregnancy clinic. If women are going online looking for abortion, we have to reach them there—and we have to reach them first. That is why PreBorn! is expanding our reach through our Virtual Care System. Through this innovative approach, we can reach women while they are looking online for answers and create an opportunity for them to connect with something profoundly different from the abortion industry: A real person who cares about her and her baby. A registered nurse can listen to what she is facing without judgment, answer her questions, provide pregnancy education, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound and continued support. And when welcomed, our nurses can pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. Friend of Life, think about the difference. The abortion industry is prepared to meet a frightened woman online and sell her pills to end the life of her baby. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. body:

---
Hi friend, At a gathering last night, we asked neighbors from around our state to finish a simple sentence:
---
_**"I dream of a Rhode Island where..."**_
---
The responses hit deep. They captured so many of the serious challenges Rhode Islanders are facing right now. From Providence, a neighbor dreamed of a Rhode Island where people have access to permanent, safe, stable and affordable homes. From Kingston, a supporter believed in a future where we no longer worry about climate change. From Warren, a friend hoped for our leaders to dream big despite being so small. These responses brought me back to one of my favorite quotes:
---
_**"A goal is a dream with its work boots on."**_
---
I am running for Lieutenant Governor, not only because I dream of a brighter future for Rhode Island, but because I have **real goals** , and a **concrete action plan** to get us there. And I want all Rhode Islanders to believe that this future is possible, and that we _can_ elect leaders who will put in the hard work to make it a reality. But with**only 15 days before the primary** , I can't reach all Rhode Islanders myself. So I am asking you to turn your dreams for Rhode Island into goals, and to take action to make them a reality.
---
_**Can you contribute $100 today to help me reach more voters like you who believe in electing leaders who don't just have big dreams, but who are ready to take big action?**_
---

---
With so much gratitude and hope, Sue A.

This is our last best chance to save Texas public schools.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Texas public schools are in crisis, Peter.**
And Greg Abbott has done _nothing_ to fix it.**In fact, in the past 3 years alone, over 170 public schools have been closed in the state — and nearly 40 percent of public school performances are falling flat.**

**As governor, I will make Texas teachers among the highest paid in the nation:** if we want the best educators for our kids, we need to treat them like the professionals they are.

We can’t afford four more years of Greg Abbott.

| | | Food safety shouldn’t be something we cut corners on. The U.S. is dealing with major foodborne illness outbreaks, including Cyclospora linked to lettuce that sickened more than 6,300 people and Salmonella linked to jalapeños that has sickened hundreds. Meanwhile, FDA employment has fallen 22% since 2024, and foreign food-facility inspections dropped nearly 13% last year. Food safety experts warn that reduced staffing and oversight can make an already strained system even harder to protect. There’s a lot of blame to go around. But there’s one person who deserves the lion’s share: Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

| | | | Peter, Last year, when Utah Senator Mike Lee introduced a disastrous proposal to auction off our national public lands, the public backlash was instantaneous and massive. So the agency explicitly tasked with protecting your public lands was secretly ghostwriting the political strategy to liquidate them. It’s clear that the entire Trump Administration views your national forests, mountains, and watersheds as nothing more than dollars on a balance sheet. We have to defend these lands ourselves. | | | Prediction markets like Polymarket have officially gone too far. From people placing bets on where and how fast devastating wildfires will burn, to political insiders profiting off non-public information about military actions—** _like reports of a Trump speechwriter predicting when a conflict with Iran would start_** —the line between forecasting and dangerous insider trading has completely blurred.

It is deeply wrong for anyone to profit from government secrets or human tragedy. And it is completely unacceptable for public employees to use non-public information learned on the job to make a quick buck on online gambling platforms. **That’s why I am drafting legislation to make it explicitly clear: state employees are strictly prohibited from participating in prediction markets based on insider information they gain at work.** Public office is a public trust—not a private trading floor. When government officials or public servants have access to sensitive information about regulatory decisions, natural disaster responses, or policy shifts, the public must be confident that those decisions are being made in the public interest, not to win a financial bet. body:
Together, we will win.

---
Derek, deciding to run for this U.S. Senate seat wasn’t easy. I didn’t really want to go to Washington DC — I had always planned on serving North Carolina from here at home. That’s why I was so humbled when North Carolinians elected me to be governor.
**But this race is too consequential. The stakes are too high. I couldn’t sit by.**
When we started this campaign, I did so with a great sense of responsibility for all of you who are putting your trust in me — and even more hope. Together, we will win.
Now, our campaign is up against a huge financial challenge: Our end-of-month deadline is on Monday at midnight. [**I’m personally asking if you can be among the supporters who help meet our $2 million goal by donating $20 right now split between our campaign and the DNC.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260825_8760_fr&refcode2=8760_22930333_dxQgeT&akid=8760%2E22930333%2EdxQgeT)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260825_8760_fr&refcode2=8760_22930333_dxQgeT&akid=8760%2E22930333%2EdxQgeT)**
Derek, I’m running because our nation cannot afford two more years of unchecked Republican power in Washington. The attacks on health care, on democratic values and even on American citizens — they have to stop.
Instead, our leaders should be focusing on strengthening our communities by investing in public schools, securing health care access and prioritizing hardworking folks over the wealthiest few. That’s what our administration did in North Carolina — creating jobs by expanding the clean energy economy, giving public school teachers a much-needed raise, expanding Medicaid and more.
**This is the work I’m ready to do as the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina, when we flip this seat from red to blue and take back the Senate for the people. But there’s a lot of hard work ahead of us first.**
This is the most competitive race of my career.
Unlike my opponent, Republican Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley, I’m not relying on massive checks from billionaires and special interests to coast to victory. The movement we’re building here is powered by small-dollar donations from people like you, Derek.
[**Chipping in $5, $25, or whatever amount is right for you split between our campaign and the DNC before our end-of-month deadline will help us meet our goal and let everyone know that the people are with us. Please pitch in before Monday if you’re with us.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260825_8760_fr&refcode2=8760_22930333_dxQgeT&akid=8760%2E22930333%2EdxQgeT)

|
Peter,
Last night, the Supreme Court allowed the Trump admin to move forward with its attempt to effectively ban mail-in ballots in blue states.
The far-right Roberts Court used the "shadow docket" to hand down this ruling. No signed opinion. No reasoning to scrutinize. No oral arguments. Just a 6-3 order along ideological lines that will cause mass chaos and confusion this November.
The Court did not even rule on whether the new USPS rule is legal. Instead, they ruled on a technicality, claiming the blue states who challenged the rule sued too early, before it was finalized. That final rule dropped Friday night, just days before the Court's ruling.

The timing of this ruling exposes SCOTUS as nothing more than puppets for Trump and MAGA extremists, attempting to sow chaos and confusion just months before the midterm elections.
Mail-in ballots start going out in less than a month in some states. This ruling forces blue states into a corner: comply, hand over your voter data, and risk that data being used by Trump to challenge election results if the Court later strikes the rule down, or wait and risk sending ballots late or even losing the ability to send ballots at all if the Court upholds it.
The Supreme Court is now working hand-in-hand with Trump to cause chaos this November. Earlier this year, they gutted the Voting Rights Act, a decision that let red states move to eliminate Black congressional districts, delay ongoing primaries, and hand Republicans more than a dozen seats.
That's what makes this ruling so disturbing. Whether or not SCOTUS ultimately rules in favor of allowing Trump to effectively ban mail-in ballots in blue states, the damage is already done. It means Democrats are not just fighting off election rigging threats from federal agencies like the DOJ, DHS, and USPS, but the highest court in the land too.
This is why Defend Our Courts mission is now more important than ever. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
This is an emergency. Trump and SCOUTS are working hand-in-hand to cause chaos ahead of the elections this November. [We need to make this election too big to rig and save our Democracy. Folks,
There's new polling out of Pennsylvania this morning, and I need you to sit with the numbers for a second.
According to Siena, alleged Democratic Senator John Fetterman is now 42 points underwater with Pennsylvania Democrats. With Pennsylvania Republicans, he's at plus 52 favorability. Read that again. The guy we elected as a progressive insurgent is now more popular with Republicans than he is with the people who actually put him in office. He is, in fact, more popular with Pennsylvania Republicans than Dave McCormick, the actual Republican senator from Pennsylvania who votes with Donald Trump and the MAGA movement basically 100 percent of the time.
Republicans are all over the internet this morning celebrating their new golden boy. And I get it. He goes on Fox almost every night, sits across from Sean Hannity, and repeats their talking points while attacking our candidates like Abdul El-Sayed and plenty of others. He's a gift to them. I've been arguing for months that Democrats need to build a Fetterman-proof Senate majority, 52 seats in November, because if we don't, I believe this guy switches parties or betrays us at the worst possible moment. Trump has essentially offered him a bribe, promising to fund his reelection if he runs, and if Trump gets another Supreme Court vacancy in the next couple of years, I think Fetterman folds. Partly because he wants the Fox airtime. Partly because the check has already been written.
I still believe all of that. But today I want to talk about something else, because this poll isn't really a story about John Fetterman. It's a story about how morally bankrupt the MAGA movement and the Republican Party have become.
* * *
**Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News.**
I'm often asked where I go to do research for my reporting. One of the main research tools I use is called **Ground News** because the same story can look completely different depending on where you read it. Just look at how hundreds of outlets covered reports of the United States surpassing $40 Trillion in debt for the first time in US history.
**The Philedelphia Tribune** _reports on the continued borrowing of the US government despite surpassing a $40 trillion debt deficit._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/985822be-86af-465e-b45d-8338a50f508c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The Daily Caller** s _ays Members of Congress, referring to them as 'swampers', bemoaned the $40 trillion national debt amid debate on how to address the deficit._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/985822be-86af-465e-b45d-8338a50f508c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Same story. Completely different framing.**
That's why I use **Ground News**. It shows you how the left and right cover the same story, what each side emphasizes or leaves out, and helps you discover overlooked stories through the **Blindspot Feed** , which surfaces coverage disproportionately reported by either side.
I was a paying subscriber before they ever sponsored Endless Urgency. It makes it much harder to get trapped in one version of a story--and because Ground News is subscriber-funded, there are no corporate interests deciding what you see.
