And Democrats in races like South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District and Virginia’s 5th Congressional District are outraising their Republican opponents, putting them in a better position to communicate with and turn out the voters they need to win. Some Republican candidates are increasingly vulnerable: In Ohio’s 7th Congressional District, for example, Rep. Max Miller is facing allegations of domestic violence and calls from prominent Republicans to end his campaign, creating a rare opening for a Democratic challenger. And we’re following volunteer energy, too: New York’s 1st Congressional District has an active Swing Left volunteer base that’s ready to engage immediately in this newly added “reach” race. They’re already seeing what’s possible here—the impact of Trump’s and Republicans’ policies is turning this district, where Trump won by just 2% in 2020, purple again. We continue to categorize our target races into Must-Flip, Must-Hold, or Reach Races. Must-Flip and Must-Hold races are the highest-priority races on our list. These are the races that Democrats must win to gain control of the House or Senate, or hold critical power in the states. Reach races are more of a stretch based on past results, current polling, or the partisan makeup of the district or state. Targeting some of these races is very ambitious, but they are also a key part of our long-term strategy, too. Organizing investment in these places now could result in an extra seat, and if we don’t win a race this November, Democrats build groundwork that will make it easier to win next time around. We take seriously what it means to ask you for your time and money. That’s why right now, we are focusing the Swing Left community’s power on organizing in these Reach races rather than fundraising. This moment requires us to be clear-eyed about the work to win these races and the investment it requires, and we know that any chance at winning starts with building organizing power on the ground. And even if we don’t win this November, the work we start now will have a lasting impact, building up a volunteer infrastructure that will outlast a single election cycle. Our goal remains ensuring your time and money go where they’ll have the biggest impact on helping Democrats not only win in the midterm elections, but to build a foundation to win and maintain Democratic governing power in 2028, 2030, and beyond. We’re putting our collective grassroots power to work in two main ways. First, through Ground Truth , our innovative voter-contact program helping Democrats reach the voters who will decide these races. And second, through building a grassroots fundraising machine that directs small-dollar donations to candidates where they'll make the biggest difference, with a particular focus on flipping Republican-held seats blue. The Swing Left community has proven in the past that grassroots dollars have the power to make a difference in close races, and now we’re aiming to replicate that success on a much larger scale than ever before. With Election Day just 10 weeks away, campaigns are hiring last-minute staff, building up voter-contact programs, holding supporter events, and reserving ad space to communicate directly with voters. Momentum might be on their side, but that momentum will mean nothing if campaigns don’t have the resources to capitalize on it now. Thank you for all you’re doing to help Democrats win, and keep winning. And stay tuned for more updates on our new target races soon! — The Swing Left Team Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power. | | | | Hi Friend,
On August 24, the Supreme Court ruled 6-3 to lift part of an injunction placed on President Trump's executive order overhauling mail-in ballots.

That order directs states to turn over voter lists and put unique barcodes on every mail ballot envelope or lose Postal Service delivery altogether, and it directs DHS to build citizenship lists from federal databases to check against state voter rolls.
**Election integrity is the backbone of our democratic system.**
I believe elections must remain secure and fair, with every legal vote counted.
Virginians deserve a representative who will fight for election integrity and uphold our Constitution. That's exactly what I will do in Congress.
But campaigns like mine do not have the resources of the entrenched political machine behind them, and it costs money to get our message in front of voters.

Lots going on, here's some of the big stuff:
### **New FEMA lawsuit**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a252866-8297-4b4a-aa87-895affec4fc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is our third FEMA lawsuit. We won the last two.
This time, FEMA told our state that they're going to cut millions of dollars that go to our first responders - think bomb squads, hurricane response, active shooter response - if we don't obey their list of requests for how we run our elections.
That's right - FEMA, the disaster response agency, is suddenly trying to leverage its funding to dictate terms on election administration.
To be honest, a lot of their requests are things we're already doing, but that's not the point.
The point is, _FEMA doesn 't run elections._ They have no authority here at all, and they shouldn't hold money for our first responders hostage. That's why they deserve to lose in court, again.
The lawsuit is now filed. I feel good about our odds.
### **HCA/Mission Health**
If you're in western NC, you already know about this.
In 2019, your biggest hospital went from non-profit to for-profit.
As part of that deal, the new for-profit hospital entered into a binding agreement to continue to provide services for emergency, trauma, and cancer care.
To be frank, that didn't happen. They have consistently been cited by federal regulators for failing to meet the standard of appropriate health care, and the people of western NC have suffered.
Well, the big news is that our lawsuit against HCA just got past the summary judgment stage.
_That means we 're going to trial._
The other side tried to get our lawsuit thrown out before we could reach trial, but the court ruled against them. That's good news, and we're looking forward to making our case in court.
### **Water contamination**
If you're in eastern NC, you already know about this.
The old DuPont chemical plant outside Fayetteville knowingly allowed water pollution by its PFAS "forever chemicals" for years - prominently including one particular kind of PFAS chemical called GenX.
The result has been contaminated drinking water for 500,000 people in our state who live downstream.
We were hoping the EPA would take this seriously and try to provide a remedy to such massive harm to our state, but they just announced a sweetheart deal with DuPont (and its successor company, Chemours, that DuPont spun off to try to avoid liability). It guarantees a grand total of zero dollars for North Carolina and practically nothing in terms of cleanup.
That's near total abandonment of our state by the federal agency that was best poised to help.
That's unacceptable, so we're asking the judge to reject the deal. The judge has the authority to do that if the deal is unfair, and this one certainly is. We weren't even consulted. It was drafted completely behind our back.
We have formally objected, provided our reasoning, and also put out the word for citizens across the state to join us in their objection, which they have.
More soon.
Best,
Jeff

clean_body: Also, massive water pollution | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Also, massive water pollution | | | Aug 25 | | | | | | | | | | | | Lots going on, here's some of the big stuff: New FEMA lawsuit | | ---|---|--- This is our third FEMA lawsuit. We won the last two. This time, FEMA told our state that they're going to cut millions of dollars that go to our first responders - think bomb squads, hurricane response, active shooter response - if we don't obey their list of requests for how we run our elections. That's right - FEMA, the disaster response agency, is suddenly trying to leverage its funding to dictate terms on election administration. To be honest, a lot of their requests are things we're already doing, but that's not the point. The point is, FEMA doesn 't run elections. They have no authority here at all, and they shouldn't hold money for our first responders hostage. That's why they deserve to lose in court, again. The lawsuit is now filed. I feel good about our odds. HCA/Mission Health If you're in western NC, you already know about this. In 2019, your biggest hospital went from non-profit to for-profit. As part of that deal, the new for-profit hospital entered into a binding agreement to continue to provide services for emergency, trauma, and cancer care. To be frank, that didn't happen. They have consistently been cited by federal regulators for failing to meet the standard of appropriate health care, and the people of western NC have suffered. Well, the big news is that our lawsuit against HCA just got past the summary judgment stage. That means we 're going to trial. The other side tried to get our lawsuit thrown out before we could reach trial, but the court ruled against them. That's good news, and we're looking forward to making our case in court. Water contamination If you're in eastern NC, you already know about this. The old DuPont chemical plant outside Fayetteville knowingly allowed water pollution by its PFAS "forever chemicals" for years - prominently including one particular kind of PFAS chemical called GenX. The result has been contaminated drinking water for 500,000 people in our state who live downstream. We were hoping the EPA would take this seriously and try to provide a remedy to such massive harm to our state, but they just announced a sweetheart deal with DuPont (and its successor company, Chemours, that DuPont spun off to try to avoid liability). It guarantees a grand total of zero dollars for North Carolina and practically nothing in terms of cleanup. That's near total abandonment of our state by the federal agency that was best poised to help. That's unacceptable, so we're asking the judge to reject the deal. The judge has the authority to do that if the deal is unfair, and this one certainly is. We weren't even consulted. It was drafted completely behind our back. We have formally objected, provided our reasoning, and also put out the word for citizens across the state to join us in their objection, which they have. More soon. Best, Jeff ? P.S. - Can you believe we've got a kid in college? Here's to Haden, the newest Seahawk at UNCW. My parting wisdom was for him to try to have 80% as much fun as possible. Feels about right. | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Jeff Jackson Jeff Jackson for Attorney General, P.O. Box 470882 Charlotte, NC 28226, United States ? ?

# [Stablecoins could supercharge demand for U.S. Treasury bills](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's larger longer-term bond buybacks, funded by increased short-term T-bill issuance, could gain support from stablecoins as a new demand source under the Trump administration's crypto legislation push.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Treasury twist strategy detailed:** Bessent announced larger buybacks of longer-term bonds last week that can be funded by boosting issuance of shorter-term Treasury bills in what he called a Treasury twist.
* **Stablecoin demand potential noted:** Bessent has previously discussed stablecoins as a significant possible new source of demand for Treasury bills amid the administration's broader crypto policy efforts.
* **Genius Act provides foundation:** President Trump signed the Genius Act last year, supplying legislative backing that connects the White House crypto agenda to Treasury's funding mechanisms.
* **Bond market taming goal linked:** The moves aim to help tame the bond market while tying crypto growth, particularly stablecoins, more closely to U.S. government debt instruments.

# [Big Tech cornered as Meta, TikTok must defend child addiction suits](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A federal appeals court refused to dismiss more than 3,000 lawsuits against Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat alleging addictive platform designs targeting young users, ruling that Section 230 offers a liability defense but not immunity from suit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Section 230 limit clarified:** The Ninth Circuit held the law provides only a defense to liability rather than immunity from being sued, rejecting the companies' premature appeal of a lower court decision.
* **Youth addiction claims proceed:** Complaints that the platforms were designed to foster addictive behavior, failed age verification and failed to block harmful content will move forward in federal court.
* **Multiple trials now cleared:** A case by 29 state attorneys general against Meta begins this Wednesday, with separate school district lawsuits scheduled for trial beginning in February.
* **Evidence disclosure expected:** Plaintiff attorneys stated the decision enables the public to learn what the companies knew about impacts on children, when they learned it and how they responded.

* * *
* * *
# [Nvidia's 7-day losing streak just entered danger zone before earnings](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia shares have dropped for seven consecutive trading days, the longest losing streak since 2022 and down about 7.5 percent, ahead of fiscal second-quarter earnings due after the bell on Wednesday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Longest streak since 2022:** The shares fell 2.9 percent on Monday alone and have underperformed the S&P 500, which declined just 1.2 percent across the same seven-day stretch of selling pressure.
* **Hyperscalers drive bulk revenue:** Amazon, Google and Microsoft account for an outsized share, representing about 55 percent of data center revenue over the past year, with first-quarter hyperscaler sales reaching $37.9 billion.
* **Analysts eye $92.2 billion:** Revenue is projected to nearly double year over year to $92.2 billion, with the data center segment expected to hit $86.3 billion or 94 percent of the total.
* **Financing plan for broader base:** Nvidia is advancing programs with financial firms that could unlock up to $500 billion to help more companies buy GPUs beyond the core group of hyperscalers.

# [Bessent unleashes Operation Economic Outcast to crush Iran's enablers](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday launched Operation Economic Outcast, sanctioning more than 60 entities worldwide and warning that any party facilitating Iranian oil revenue or sanctions evasion risks being cut off from the American financial system.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dozens of Chinese targets:** Nearly 60 Iran-linked designations hit Chinese and Hong Kong firms plus individuals such as Sweet Ocean Industrial Ltd., Li Na, Tian Jianbai and Zhang Limei for procurement support.
* **Big banks intentionally spared:** Major Chinese lenders were left off the list ahead of the Trump-Xi summit next month to pressure Iran without triggering a broader confrontation or trade disruption.
* **Oil trade exposure mapped:** China accounted for around 90 percent of Iranian oil exports, or about 12 percent of its own crude imports, while UAE, Turkey, Iraq and India also face secondary risks.
* **Beijing signals firm pushback:** Chinese foreign ministry officials stated they will take all necessary measures to safeguard national interests and oppose unilateral sanctions without international law or UN authorization.

# [Bitcoin crosses $80,000 after Treasury buyback plans emerge](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bitcoin rose above the $80,000 level on Tuesday, extending a rally triggered by the Treasury Department's plans to double buybacks of longer-dated Treasurys, and now outperforms gold and the S&P 500 over six months.
* **Price details confirmed:** The cryptocurrency hovered around the $79,800 mark early Tuesday after earlier reaching $80,600 according to the CoinDesk index, a level last touched in May.
* **ETF attracts billion:** The iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF attracted about $1 billion last week and recorded its largest daily inflow since January on Friday when $503 million was added.
* **Year-to-date still down:** Even after the recent surge the highly volatile cryptocurrency remains down so far in 2026 while gold prices are up over 8% this year.
* **RSI enters overbought:** Following the Treasury Department's announcement both the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF and SPDR Gold Shares rose into overbought territory on the 14-day relative strength index.

* * *
# [Pentagon hands Boeing $131 billion for F-15 upgrades and support](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Boeing received a $131 billion contract focused on maintaining and upgrading F-15 fighter jets, delivering a notable boost to the aerospace giant's defense business.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/02bb673d-ae4c-48ba-852e-f8554af03249?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New contract valued at $131 billion:** The award specifically covers maintenance and upgrades for the F-15 program, marking a substantial commitment to Boeing's military aircraft support activities.
* **Defense business gains momentum:** This large-scale deal provides an important lift to the defense segment of Boeing by securing long-term work on the established F-15 platform.
* **F-15 fleet support expanded:** Resources under the contract will go toward ongoing maintenance needs as well as upgrades that keep the fighter jets operational and modernized.
* **Revenue visibility for defense:** The $131 billion figure offers extended financial backing and operational continuity specifically within Boeing's defense-related operations and programs.

# [Volkswagen turnaround puts 140,000 jobs on the chopping block](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Labor representatives at Volkswagen warn the company could eliminate as many as 140,000 jobs under a turnaround plan that CEO Oliver Blume is set to unveil later today.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/552f641e-e19c-44d5-b7b9-988f1334befe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **European capacity further cut:** Management is considering cutting another 500,000 vehicles from annual European production capacity along with workforce reductions and potential shutdowns of some production lines.
* **Union calls margins fantasy:** IG Metall head Christiane Benner branded the plan to achieve 9 percent margins while eliminating massive numbers of workers as "cloud cuckoo land."
* **China sales and costs crush:** VW earnings have been crushed by sliding sales in China, high labor and energy costs in Germany, and a flood of Chinese electric vehicles undercutting brands.
* **Industrial core faces crisis:** The potential cuts at Germany's largest manufacturer by revenue underscore the deepening crisis inside the nation's industrial base and broader European manufacturing.

# Join Us Live for the IACC Meeting
---
|
---
| The **Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee (IACC)** will hold its next public meeting on **Thursday, August 27th at 6:00 AM PST / 9:00 AM EST** , and we invite you to tune in live. During this important meeting, the Committee will continue discussions on the **2026–2028 IACC Strategic Plan** , a roadmap designed to help guide future autism research, services, supports, and federal priorities. The Strategic Plan reflects the collective efforts of researchers, clinicians, self advocates, family members, community leaders, and federal agencies working together to improve outcomes for individuals with autism and their families. This is an excellent opportunity to hear directly from Committee members and the community, learn more about the future direction of autism policy and research, and stay informed on the important work being done at the national level. **The meeting is open to the public.**
Please use the **live streaming link below** to watch the meeting. We hope you will join us as we continue working toward a healthier future for the autism community.

# Join Us for Our September Autism Support Group
---
|
---
| We invite you to join us for our next **Autism Support Group** on **Tuesday, September 8th at 4:00 PM PST / 7:00 PM EST** via Zoom. Whether you are a parent, caregiver, family member, self advocate, or professional, this monthly gathering provides a welcoming and supportive space to connect with others who understand the autism journey. Our support group is an opportunity to share experiences, ask questions, exchange resources, celebrate victories, and receive encouragement from a compassionate community. Together, we learn from one another, discuss challenges and solutions, and build meaningful relationships that remind us we are never alone. At Autism Health, we believe that connection is one of the most powerful tools for healing and hope. No matter where you are on your journey, you are welcome to join us. **Advance registration through Zoom is required to attend.** Please register using the link below to receive your Zoom access information. We look forward to seeing you on **Tuesday, September 8th at 4:00 PM PST!**

| | | | | | Peter,
Josh Shapiro took more than $5 million from out of state data center interests. He rolled out the red carpet for them, offered tax breaks and fast-tracked permits, and posed for press conferences celebrating their arrival.
Then we listened to you. We went to communities across Pennsylvania and heard your concerns about rising electric bills, disappearing farmland, and a Governor who wasn’t paying attention. I called for a data center pause. The polls shifted. The momentum changed.
**And Shapiro panicked.**
Now the same Governor who cheerleaded this industry is suddenly signing executive orders calling developers “predatory.” The same companies that gave him $5 million — he’s now vilifying them on camera. As one columnist wrote this week: it’s never about us. It’s always about him.
**He’s trying to lie his way to reelection. And I need your help to make sure those lies don’t go unchallenged.**
**Here’s what you can do right now:**
We’ve put out an ad that tells the truth about Shapiro and data centers. Watch it and share it with everyone you know:

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: ICE arrested a man at a Santa Fe clinic. Here's his record.
body:
Plus, a new poll has Haaland up 17 and it isn't worth much | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/R0vzp2SkG2C?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | ICE arrested a man outside a clinic in Santa Fe last week and his 11-year-old daughter was standing right there. Source New Mexico ran it. A congresswoman held a news conference about it the next day and introduced a bill. [Nobody mentioned that the same man had four charges against him in 2018](https://us.list-manage.com/AxOWbIssFQC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) and every one of them got dismissed without a trial. There's also a poll out this week showing Deb Haaland up 17 in the Governor’s race. Don't believe it.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Elos_k0XJOK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🔥 **THE PART THAT DIDN'T MAKE THE NEWS CONFERENCE**
The man ICE picked up had a case in Santa Fe County from 2018. Four charges, and they were serious ones. He was never convicted of any of them. When Mark pulled the record you can see why. There's a line next to all four counts and it says the same thing every time.
Mark put the whole record up on screen so you can read it yourself, because most of what's in there he can't say out loud without the video getting buried.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/y0KFewSlPfv?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🚨 **GOV POLL SAYS 41 TO 24, AND YOU SHOULD IGNORE ALL OF IT**
Gabe Sanchez put out a poll this week that has Deb Haaland beating Gregg Hull by 17 points in the race for Governor, and it got picked up everywhere.
Mark's been on the ballot twice and has paid for more polling than he'd like to think about, so he went through this one line by line. He found four problems with how it was done.
**He also says there are two polls coming that are worth paying attention to, and he tells you roughly when they'll show up.

** 💰 **THEY WENT AHEAD AND SIGNED THE BILL ABOUT NICK SHIRLEY**
Nick was on the show about a month ago, right after California introduced a bill aimed at people who film and publish investigations into fraud. Newsom signed it Saturday.
The legislator who wrote the bill is married to California's Attorney General, and going after fraud is most of what an Attorney General does. Nick's take on what happens over the next year or so is worth hearing, because he's the one it's aimed at.

**AND CALIFORNIA IS COMING FOR YOUR TIRES**
A new rule out there requires about seventy percent of the tires sold in the state today to be off the shelf by 2033. The ones that replace them cost more, wear out faster, and don't hold the road as well when it's wet. If you drive a truck for work, you get the least choice about any of it.
We were just out there and the gas station had something posted right on the pump that tells you everything about how that state runs.

🏈 **FROM SHIPROCK TO THE DALLAS COWBOYS**
Shiyazh Pete went to high school in Shiprock, he's six foot nine, and he's the first member of the Navajo Nation ever to sign with an NFL team. He got in for a few snaps against the Cardinals on Saturday, fourth quarter, with the game already decided. Mark doesn't think he makes the 53-man roster, and he explains what he's hoping happens instead.
PLUS: Trump has dropped 51 points with Hispanic men since 2024 and Mark thinks the whole thing comes down to one issue. Rubio is beating Vance in every 2028 matchup that's been polled. Chris Wright came to Hobbs and made the case for nuclear. And Europe, after spending years lecturing this country about climate, is quietly undoing most of it.
---

Fellow Patriot,
I need to speak with you directly.
**Democrats in Florida just nominated a self-proclaimed socialist in the biggest Senate special election of 2026.**
_**Her name is Angie Nixon. ** _
She publicly and proudly joined the Democratic Socialists of America during her campaign.
She’s a former “community organizer” who literally runs a bookstore called Cafe Resistance.
She’s endorsed by The Squad and held one of her final rallies with Hamas superfan Rashida Tlaib.
**And she just defeated an incredibly well-funded Democrat with a nearly $17 million war chest** _**by more than ten points after raising less than a million dollars.** _
This is not a fringe candidate who stumbled into a nomination. And the socialist movement gobbling up seats all across the country can no longer be excused as some obscure “wing” of the Democratic Party.
**The heart and soul and energy of the Democrats is now with the socialists, and with the support of President Trump and patriots all across the nation, I’m ready to bury this twisted ideology in Florida.**
You and I love this country. We love freedom, the rule of law, and the belief that hard work and responsibility matter. We do not get up every day and work hard, raise our families and build our communities just to see the evil and failed socialist ideology destroy everything we love.
_**This is the line in the sand.** _

Angie Nixon is not just another “progressive.”
_**She stormed the Florida House floor with a bullhorn. ** _
_**She got herself arrested in the Governor’s office. ** _
_**She calls ICE detention centers “concentration camps” and wants to abolish the agency. ** _
These are not policy differences. This is a worldview that rejects the foundations of the country we both cherish.

The national Left will now pour everything they have into cleaning up her image and making her look mainstream. Special elections are unpredictable, and they know it.
**That is why we cannot wait. We have to define this race early and politically bury this radical before their machine can rebrand her.**

[ **I am ready for this fight. I have spent my career defending the law and protecting Florida families. body:
Abdul doesn't have a $51 million machine behind him. He has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and he never will.
Peter,
**21.** That's how many days we're into the general election fight for Michigan's Senate seat.
**$51,000,000.** That's how much the GOP’s Senate Leadership Fund has committed to spend boosting Mike Rogers and flipping this seat red.
**$10.** That's what we're asking you to give today to support Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan and Heartland Patriots.
Abdul doesn't have a $51 million machine behind him. He has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and he never will.

* * *
Dear David, I’m a product of public education. My husband, Eric, is a public middle school teacher. Our kids go to public schools. I know the value of a public school system that teaches our children the skills they need to thrive and contribute meaningfully to our society and that encourages them to learn from and alongside people who are different from them. **[In Congress, I’ll fight for fully funded public schools, to stop the privatization of education, and to make sure working families are not the ones paying the price for politicians’ ideological crusades. New Hampshire ranks DEAD LAST in funding for public schools. **That’s right, David: dead last.**
And somehow, Republicans in Concord, who have refused FOR DECADES to fix this problem despite several Supreme Court rulings saying their approach to funding schools is unconstitutional, are making it _worse_.
For example, take the situation in Claremont. Last year, the Claremont School District faced a budget crisis that left it in a $5 million hole. It was a real crisis, and because of the abysmal way New Hampshire funds public schools, Claremont had to deal with it almost entirely on its own.
The school district had to lay off teachers, close schools, and shift money out of clubs and athletics to fill the budget shortfall. Kids in Claremont suffered, while Republicans did nothing but craft the most punitive and unhelpful legislation imaginable.
**Donald Trump is no better.**
The voucher program created by New Hampshire Republicans has been taken nationwide by the Trump administration. This scheme takes money from public schools and transfers it to wealthy families, the vast majority of whom already send their children to private and religious schools.
The program has blown past its initial budget, leaving public schools with even less than expected, which means that local communities will have to cover the shortfall by, you guessed it, **raising property taxes.**
**[Our kids deserve so much better, and I need your help to fight for them in Congress. David, please pitch in if you can. name: Molly Gray
subject: Healthcare should work for Vermonters
body:
Dear Peter, Last week, I had the opportunity to tour a [Community Health Center](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137907155/642336796/1729152793?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWQyMGM2MC1iNWEwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TLt6mYMDYl3O0ZFWRV_HK6Ow0bNeUj4o2IquwbmzIvM=&emci=e3b31a64-b4a0-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=9ed20c60-b5a0-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=43402276) location and hear directly from providers and leaders about what’s working (and what’s not) when it comes to meeting the primary, dental, and mental health needs of Vermonters in Grand Isle and Chittenden counties. Community Health Centers provide high-quality, comprehensive care while meeting patients where they are. They offer a model we can build on across Vermont. That matters because our healthcare system is failing too many Vermonters. Healthcare costs are **bankrupting families, crushing employers, and driving up property taxes**. Vermont’s health insurance premiums are among the highest in the nation, and employers have seen premiums increase by **35% over the last three years**. At the same time, rural communities are [losing access to care.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137907157/642336797/370650856?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWQyMGM2MC1iNWEwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TLt6mYMDYl3O0ZFWRV_HK6Ow0bNeUj4o2IquwbmzIvM=&emci=e3b31a64-b4a0-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=9ed20c60-b5a0-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=43402276) Vermonters are paying more and getting less. As Lt. Governor, I’ll prioritize addressing our healthcare access and affordability head on with real solutions. I believe healthcare is a human right, and we need to prioritize prevention and primary care, not profit from illness. That means:
* **Universal primary care for every Vermonter,** regardless of age, income, or zip code.
* **Growing our primary care workforce** , especially in rural communities, potentially through loan forgiveness and scholarships.
* **Reducing unnecessary hospital administrative costs** so more healthcare dollars go toward patient care.
* **Implementing reference-based pricing** to address extreme price variation and prevent price-gouging.
* **Building on the Community Health Center model** to expand accessible, community-based physical and mental healthcare.

We don't have to accept a healthcare system that costs more every year while delivering less for Vermonters. We can make Vermont a place where families can afford to see a doctor, employers can afford to provide coverage, and every community has access to high-quality care. **But building that future will take a strong campaign through the general election and the resources to reach voters across all 14 counties.** With ballots going out on October 1, we have no time to waste. **[Will you make a contribution today to help us win this race and deliver meaningful healthcare reform to Vermonters?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137907159/642336800/679520187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWQyMGM2MC1iNWEwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TLt6mYMDYl3O0ZFWRV_HK6Ow0bNeUj4o2IquwbmzIvM=)**

clean_body: Dear Peter, Last week, I had the opportunity to tour a location and hear directly from providers and leaders about what’s working (and what’s not) when it comes to meeting the primary, dental, and mental health needs of Vermonters in Grand Isle and Chittenden counties. Community Health Centers provide high-quality, comprehensive care while meeting patients where they are. They offer a model we can build on across Vermont. That matters because our healthcare system is failing too many Vermonters. Healthcare costs are bankrupting families, crushing employers, and driving up property taxes. Vermont’s health insurance premiums are among the highest in the nation, and employers have seen premiums increase by 35% over the last three years. At the same time, rural communities are Vermonters are paying more and getting less. As Lt. Governor, I’ll prioritize addressing our healthcare access and affordability head on with real solutions. I believe healthcare is a human right, and we need to prioritize prevention and primary care, not profit from illness. That means: Universal primary care for every Vermonter, regardless of age, income, or zip code. Growing our primary care workforce , especially in rural communities, potentially through loan forgiveness and scholarships. Reducing unnecessary hospital administrative costs so more healthcare dollars go toward patient care. Implementing reference-based pricing to address extreme price variation and prevent price-gouging. Building on the Community Health Center model to expand accessible, community-based physical and mental healthcare. We don't have to accept a healthcare system that costs more every year while delivering less for Vermonters. We can make Vermont a place where families can afford to see a doctor, employers can afford to provide coverage, and every community has access to high-quality care. But building that future will take a strong campaign through the general election and the resources to reach voters across all 14 counties. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today marks exactly ten weeks until the 2026 general election.

Ten weeks to further shape the future of the Democratic Party.

Ten weeks to elect three more Justice Democrats to Congress, expanding our
progressive bloc in Washington for the people-first agenda we desperately
need.

Ten weeks to unseat two corporate-backed Democratic incumbents and stop a
MAGA Republican from flipping a House seat from blue to red.

We have the momentum, which is why the establishment and their super PACs
have been fighting back with everything to stop us in our tracks. That’s
why we’re asking you directly:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260825.XunALY&refcode=em20260825-38195&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38195%2E1203867%2ETTXhG0 ]Will you chip in $10 today to fuel our movement over these final ten
weeks?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260825.XunALY&refcode=em20260825-38195&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38195%2E1203867%2ETTXhG0 ]Contribute $10

This has been Justice Democrats’ most successful election cycle
ever, Peter.

Across the country, everyday people are showing up and proving that
they’re sick of the status-quo politics on both sides of the aisle that
have left working families behind for decades. They’re tired of the
Do-Nothing Democrats cashing checks from corporations and special
interests that hike up our healthcare costs and fund illegal wars just to
hold onto power.

People are ready for unbought leaders who put people over profits and stay
accountable to the communities they’re meant to serve.

That grassroots energy is exactly how we’ve already helped 7 Justice
Democrats win their primaries to advance to Congress so far this year —
and come November 3rd, we’re ready to make that 10.

Unlike our opponents, our resources don’t come from billionaire donors or
corporate PACs — we and our candidates rely entirely on supporters like
you chipping in what you can, when you can.

With only 10 weeks left, a $10 contribution today could make all the
difference between winning and losing these critical seats. We’ve
delivered multiple historic blows and upsets to the establishment these
last few months. Now, we have to put everything we have into these final
ten weeks to finish the job.

Justice Democrats

body:
A fire chief lost his free speech case. The day after, he published a book.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Gov. Polis asked Trump for a [major disaster declaration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after the Aspen Acres and Gold Mountain fires burned 140,000+ acres, destroyed 324 homes, and forced 11,600 evacuations. Voters will decide in November on Initiative 232, [capping the income tax at 4.4%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), competing directly with a graduated-tax measure. An Aurora council committee [opposed statewide Initiative 85](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which would make any fentanyl possession a felony. A former Durango teacher [got 40 years for posing online as a teen girl](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to solicit images from dozens of boys. And former Florissant Fire Chief Erik Holt lost his free-speech retaliation case when the Tenth Circuit ruled his actions were official duties, not protected speech, exposing a [gap in whistleblower protections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for special-district employees.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** A Just the News review found billions in USAID funds lost to fraud, theft, and mismanagement, including a [decade-hidden half-billion-dollar bribery scheme](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), as Trump cuts foreign aid and shifts functions to the State Department.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Pastor Drake Hunter urged Christians to speak with more discretion rather than engaging every cultural fight. Kim Gilmartin criticized a Douglas County proposal letting boards [deny new charters based on impact to existing schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And Jay Davidson argued capitalism reflects human nature's blend of self-interest and enlightenment while socialism relies on [central planners who override individual choice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, August 25, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[A fire chief lost his free speech case. The day after, he published a book.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Erik Holt read the opinion the morning it came down on July 7 at 9 a.m. Three federal judges had decided that when the former Florissant fire chief handed election surveillance footage to a criminal investigator examining alleged misconduct in the board’s election, he was doing his job, not speaking as a citizen.
That single finding ended his case. It meant the federal courts would never reach whether the board fired him in retaliation. He wrote the last chapter of his book that day. He submitted it for publishing the next.
“I used the very First Amendment that the court said I didn’t have to publish a book and tell my story,” Holt said.
RMV has followed Holt’s case since November 2025, in reports on the [surveillance footage and dismissed complaint](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), on the [uncertified board transition](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that preceded his firing, and on his [federal appeal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) this spring.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[DougCo’s charter proposal protects schools from competition, not choice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KIM GILMARTIN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A school-choice advocate warns that Douglas County's push to expand charter denial grounds could quietly shield existing schools from the competition families deserve._
* **Expanding grounds to deny new charters:** Douglas County School District's resolution, submitted to the Colorado Association of School Boards, would let local boards weigh a proposed charter's "educational, programmatic, enrollment, and fiscal impacts" on existing schools — which CASB's own materials describe as expanding the grounds for denying a new charter.
* **Protecting enrollment, not evaluating quality:** Kim Gilmartin argues there's a critical difference between assessing whether a new charter is financially viable and asking whether a new charter's success would hurt existing schools' enrollment — the latter gives the current system an incentive to block competition rather than earn families' continued support.
* **Timing raises fairness questions:** The proposal comes as DCSD asks voters, including the roughly 26% of its students enrolled in charter schools, to approve a $54 million Mill Levy Override — prompting Gilmartin to ask whether the district is equally committed to protecting the choices those charter families have already made.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Davidson: Capitalism trusts you to choose. Socialism does not.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JAY DAVIDSON | COMMENTARY | AUGUST 24** _Only one economic system accounts for human nature. Economics is the study of human nature. It seeks to explain how individuals interact in the exchange of a medium of value: money, barter, services, etc. Psychology, social science, even philosophy also study human nature. Whereas these studies can affect us at different times, the economy constantly affects us._
**[The Discretion Weapon: Hey Diddle Diddle (When the Church Goes Helter-Skelter)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | AUGUST 23** _As children, we probably never stopped to consider just how helter-skelter that little nursery rhyme really is. The cat is playing a fiddle. The cow is flying over the moon. The dog is laughing, and apparently the dish and spoon have decided they have had enough of the kitchen and are running away together. You see... everything is moving, but nothing is functioning as it should._
**[A change order, not an amendment: How Denver moved $18 million past City Council](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | AUGUST 21** _A contractor digging up 16th Street hit a brick sewer the city hadn’t mapped. The cost of Denver’s signature downtown project jumped by $18 million, the finish line slid back nearly a year, and City Council found out after the deal was done._

But if an American wants to preserve his dignity and his equality as a human being, he must not bow his neck to any dictatorial government."_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

I am absolutely gutted to hear the news of Dolly Parton's passing. Queen Dolly is an icon all over the world, but she _is_ East Tennessee. I'll take heart and inspiration from Dolly's own words today: "When I wake up, I expect things to be good. If they're not, then I try to set about trying to make them as good as I can . . . Some days, they pan out a little better than others, **_but you still gotta always just try_**." Dolly did so much not only to achieve her own dreams, but to help kids all over the country achieve theirs. May we all be inspired by her heart, humor, generosity, and love for East Tennessee. name: Gina Hinojosa HQ
subject: The fight that started it all
body:
Gina never planned to run for office – now she’s only one point behind Abbott.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Gina Hinojosa never planned to run for office, Peter.**
In 2012, state budget cuts threatened to close her son's elementary school. Instead of waiting to see what would happen, she chose to fight. She organized parents, ran for school board, and won. They kept her son's school open — and every other public school in the district.
**That fight changed everything. It showed her that ordinary people can do extraordinary things when they decide to fight for what matters.**
Today, the state of education in Texas is _getting worse._
With Greg Abbott in office, **170** schools have closed in the last three years, and **150** school districts have moved to **four-day weeks**. He diverted **$1 billion away from public schools** to fund his voucher scam. Thousands of experienced teachers have left the classroom, replaced by uncertified first-time teachers.
This is the fight Gina is carrying into her race for Governor.
**She helped negotiate the historic 2019 school finance bill that put $11 billion back into Texas classrooms. She's fought to reduce the number of STAAR tests our kids take. And she's fought Abbott's voucher scam four separate times.**
Our kids deserve smaller class sizes, less high-stakes testing, and teachers who are paid like the professionals they are.

subject: “This is NOT supposed to be a close race!”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jamie Davis for U
body:
MAGA is shocked we're competitive. A Black farmer from rural Louisiana isn't supposed to threaten their Senate seat. But here we are.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XdAeWW1l4vn4-ykkfiZ2pL61lbxleOJIv5V_abegzhxTEFGnNs1OMFtb42CEfe4vz5iM25O6rXtQzQ-UyBROG662AQtUA3gLPKQDfxht72wwrvh19YhMyFqsyqS4gzJqYRnWDituzr7WasJvPD3Vn9vpeK9HpjM5-16I8M2djLuFc4qutm5ArdnIfkJpjnhS7-QapEB6y43VxscddJ07H-lIMAHGknnK&c=-UGysG6ISclqx1UR1J6XTFv6R-7cl-bteDmxpbtv7es284-bVLZOKA==&ch=Uv4fzuNyR7PccrGylIoQXtlhcwB5ctex8qtMsPZuomh9SK62zHi73Q==)
---
| Let me be honest with you about something.
I'm not supposed to be in this race.
The grandson of a sharecropper? Not supposed to be a viable Senate candidate in Louisiana.
A Black farmer from rural Tensas Parish? Not supposed to compete statewide in the Deep South.
Someone without billionaire backers or a Rolodex full of Washington insiders? Not supposed to have a shot at flipping a Senate seat.
But here we are.
And MAGA is absolutely shocked.
They thought Louisiana was locked up. They thought they could focus on defending seats in swing states while the South stayed safely red. They thought a race like ours -- a real populist challenge to their grip on power -- wasn't possible here.
They were wrong.
Look at what's happening: Democrats flipping Trump districts across the South. MAGA candidates tearing each other apart in primaries. Republican retirements at levels not seen since the Great Depression. Trump's approval cratering over his failed Iran war.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opening. The kind of moment that doesn't come around often in Louisiana politics.
And I believe -- deep in my bones -- that I'm the candidate to meet this moment.
Not because I'm the most polished politician. Not because I've been planning a Senate run my whole career. But because I understand what working Louisianans need because I've lived their struggles.
I know what it's like to watch costs rise while your income stays flat. I know what it's like to compete against corporations that rig the system against family operations. I know what it's like to worry about whether there will be anything left for the next generation.
That's the authentic economic populism that can win here. Not the fake MAGA version that delivers nothing but culture wars -- the real thing that actually fights for working people.
And if we capitalize on this moment -- if we show the political world that Louisiana is genuinely winnable -- everything changes.
Not just for this race. For the entire map. For what's possible in the South.
But only if we have the resources to compete. And that counts on good folks like you stepping up.

But here we are. | | | | | == | Let me be honest with you about something. I'm not supposed to be in this race. The grandson of a sharecropper? Not supposed to be a viable Senate candidate in Louisiana. A Black farmer from rural Tensas Parish? Not supposed to compete statewide in the Deep South. Someone without billionaire backers or a Rolodex full of Washington insiders? Not supposed to have a shot at flipping a Senate seat. But here we are. And MAGA is absolutely shocked. They thought Louisiana was locked up. They thought they could focus on defending seats in swing states while the South stayed safely red. They thought a race like ours -- a real populist challenge to their grip on power -- wasn't possible here. They were wrong. Look at what's happening: Democrats flipping Trump districts across the South. MAGA candidates tearing each other apart in primaries. Republican retirements at levels not seen since the Great Depression. Trump's approval cratering over his failed Iran war. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opening. The kind of moment that doesn't come around often in Louisiana politics. And I believe -- deep in my bones -- that I'm the candidate to meet this moment. Not because I'm the most polished politician. Not because I've been planning a Senate run my whole career. But because I understand what working Louisianans need because I've lived their struggles. I know what it's like to watch costs rise while your income stays flat. I know what it's like to compete against corporations that rig the system against family operations. I know what it's like to worry about whether there will be anything left for the next generation. That's the authentic economic populism that can win here. Not the fake MAGA version that delivers nothing but culture wars -- the real thing that actually fights for working people. And if we capitalize on this moment -- if we show the political world that Louisiana is genuinely winnable -- everything changes. Not just for this race. For the entire map. For what's possible in the South. But only if we have the resources to compete. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. Last week handed Democrats something real. Primaries in Florida, Wyoming, and Alaska showed cracks in Trump's hold on his own party. Mike Lindell got smoked in Minnesota and still hasn't conceded. Trump-backed candidates are losing. That's the story.
Now the one I didn't want to cover. But we're covering it because that's what we do here.
Two officers whose names are on the January 6th plaque have been charged with stealing over $441,000 in fraudulent overtime. Officer Franz Fulcher. Officer Peter Sheldon. Their names are on that plaque. They were in that building. So was I.
I'll say it plainly. I don't care what they did on January 6th. Accountability doesn't have a resume attached to it. Doesn't matter what you've sacrificed, who you protected, or which side you were on. When you break the law, you answer for it. Nobody gets a pass. Not the rioters Trump pardoned. Not the officers who defended us. Nobody.
And then there's Hakeem Jeffries and Jared Kushner. I held off on this one because I wanted to hear Jeffries respond to the backlash first.
He did. And I've got a lot to say about it including what it actually tells you that he felt the need to respond at all, what the base is genuinely asking for right now, and what I think needs to happen next.

body:
An update from the road
| | | | [](https://link.emails.bofrench.)
---
|
---
| |
friend,
This has been an action packed couple of weeks.
After a day of meetings with oilfield workers and the great O&G workers of West Texas, I spoke with the great patriots of the Lubbock Republican Women chapter at their annual Pink Elephant Gala.
My message to all the great patriots I meet is simple: this November, Texas Energy is on the ballot.
If Republicans fail to turn out and support the ticket all the way down, James Talarico, Radical Rosenthal, and their socialist ilk down ballot will raise our gas prices and destroy our state.
First they will come for Texas Energy, which is the backbone of our economy and the basis for Texas’ privileged spot as a global beacon for freedom.
Once the Democrats shut down the oilfields and costs explode, they will use the government to intrude on every aspect of our lives.
We are only ever one election away from backsliding. Democrats will open the border and before you know it, Texas will be destroyed.
**Lubbock Republican Women** As I said above, I had the great privilege of speaking at the Lubbock Republican Women gala last week. It was encouraging to campaign alongside Speaker Burrows, Mayes Middleton, Benny Johnson, and many other great candidates as we work to keep Texas red. My message was clear: I will lower gas prices, and my opponent will raise them.

---

**TIPRO Annual Conference** I also had the privilege of speaking to the Texas Independent Producers and Royalty Owners Association (TIPRO) at their conference in San Antonio. It is clear that me that Texas energy producers are ready to help Keep Texas Red this November.

**Robertson County Republican Women** This Saturday, I spoke at the Robertson County Republican Women's Gala in Bremond. It was great to address the 400 patriots in the room and encourage them in their great work of getting out the rural vote for Republicans.

This summer has been incredibly busy as I travel the state spreading our message of defeating the radical Left and lowering gas prices. But like you, I will do whatever it takes to ensure Republican victory all the way down the ballot this November.
I look forward to sharing more campaign updates with you in the coming weeks. Thank you for everything you do for our great State.
If you are able, please consider clicking the button below and making a small donation. The Democrats are going to spend half a billion dollars trying to take over our state, and I need help to stop them.

Johnson is the most feckless, ineffective, and incompetent Speaker in history.
| | | | | [](https://jseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XSF8_UXB5OWpmg17Nfv6L7OgVrik74C6JggYqE6jn57_BL4Q0n7XWYuP05DpUkPGkEN8rGQg4blh_C19ZKf0Tdskvwyq71Xoanp0yM3A52JvfDBRMxFQAvb8FB9w4BDcxghsVQp3G_vE1-gYBkA4N8NEqRevCbfDv4IOVzQDuju_rP4Xbpx9nPsZ25ENV7u_uqECp3XwCKqVf29ZJkmLomDD2y_EiSbA&c=ZRslFf2tQruI_jq2KN_SQ6MhEDZXl94T3vAo0iuMwIi94GII8OJa5A==&ch=wC5hdlAwWWYf0QaUfZFVi-gyP4HT2_uTkjPB4GItgHAxGn-zFL3O3w==)

This is just sad, even for a man like him who has no self-respect:
Mike Johnson, Speaker of the House, unironically said that many on Trump's staff consider him to be "co-president" because "the president and I speak all the time."
OK, Mike. Sure.
But honestly, if Johnson wants to lay claim to the Iran War disaster, cuts to the FDA and public health leading to deadly and horrifying foodborne illness outbreaks, a growing measles epidemic due to vaccine skepticism, crazy high gas prices and unaffordable housing...he can have it.
Because the truth is that Mike Johnson actually is responsible for the horrible direction of our country. He could pass bills to fix every single crisis. He just won't.
He could wipe away medical debt in an instant.
He could stop illegal wars, regulate AI, break up Big Tech monopolies, tax billionaires, and make life better for everyone. But he won't. Because his boss, the REAL president, doesn't want him to.

The timing of HHS's newest **[report](https://substack.com/redirect/76e5a03e-7b56-428f-aa21-9bc399452dd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , _**Wolves in White Coats** : How Doctors and Hospitals Pushed and Profited from the Fraud of "Gender Medicine, _feels almost prescient. Just days before it was released, I logged onto Facebook and saw a lengthy post from a name I didn't recognize. After reading through it, I realized that this was a girl I had gone to high school with who was publicly coming out as transgender.
This facebook post, and the subsequent name change, were her way of finally telling people after years of therapies and treatments. Heartbreakingly, she detailed that she had been taking hormones that had made her extremely sick and overweight, which led to further body dysmorphia. She had been moving between mental facilities for several years, and was about to enter a new long-term inpatient clinic several states away from her family.
She explained that transitioning had caused her to quit her job and stop connecting with friends. At the end of the post, she had an Amazon link where she was requesting new clothes and Hello Kitty coloring books.

### **[Gold has had a tremendous run. So it's only natural to wonder... did you already miss it?](https://substack.com/redirect/3180f8e3-efde-468d-a741-b12cbf58f63d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
But that may be the wrong question.
* The real question isn't whether gold has already gone up. It's whether the reasons for owning it have changed.
* Central banks continue buying gold at record levels. Global debt continues to grow. Countries around the world are looking to reduce their dependence on the U.S. dollar.
* Those are the very reasons many people have considered owning physical gold and silver for years.

And if those reasons haven't changed... **why would the case for owning them?**
If you're looking to better understand your options, request Augusta's free Gold IRA Guide. It explains how physical gold, silver, and Gold IRAs can fit into a long-term wealth protection strategy, so you can decide what's right for your retirement.

* * *
* * *
Unfortunately, this girl's experience confirmed exactly what that HHS report had just alleged: Doctors and hospitals have been pushing gender ideology on adolescents for profit. Medical professionals used their positions of power to trap children and their families in expensive, ongoing treatments. According to the report, predatory gender clinics were "promised a new stream of continuous revenue for pediatrics, endocrinology, and surgical specialties by taking physiologically healthy young people- who otherwise would not come to see medical attention (though they might require mental health care)-- and rendering dependent for life on the medical system."
The medical industry knew exactly what it was doing by normalizing gender ideology. Spending on mental health resources has increased significantly in the past few decades. Since 2000, mental health spending has nearly **[tripled](https://substack.com/redirect/d89ee375-5848-4952-8dec-dd256f7ce840?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , rising from $40.9 billion to $139.6 billion. Seeing this trend of mental health spending, medical institutions realized that introducing poorly tested "gender care" treatments could turn similar profits. The concept of "gender dysphoria" didn't even appear in the _DSM_ until **[2013](https://substack.com/redirect/ca8049ed-1efe-4dca-9c66-915a605a683a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
While **[average pediatric care](https://substack.com/redirect/7feac9a9-9c22-4ae2-be30-96ca88503536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** is typically $3,000, transgender patients frequently spend up to $75,000 before they turn 18. When surgeries are included, lifetime spending can climb to $170,000. The Doctors and medical institutions who had vowed to protect America's youth instead took advantage of its growing mental health crisis. Young people who were experiencing the typical pains of adolescence and puberty were given false diagnoses so that they would be reliable customers.
* * *
* * *

* * *
* * *
The report explains that many of the diagnoses were, indeed, fabricated. Doctors told patients that they have "unspecified" endocrine disorders. However, HHS studies found that on 4.7% of patients who were diagnosed with "unspecified" endocrine disorders actually had one.
Another study pointed out that there was a 30% rise in the number of general pediatric endocrine disorders, raising suspicions about whether or not they are valid. In a letter to A.G. Todd Blanche, JD Vance alleged that over diagnosing patients allowed hospitals "to bill insurance companies tens of millions of dollars for medications like puberty blockers."
My friend was one of far too many young people who were tricked into believing that experimental surgeries and cross sex hormones would make them feel better. Growing up, I watched as my friends gradually went from using nonbinary pronouns to injecting themselves with testosterone during our lunch period.
By the time I turned 18, I had several classmates excitedly preparing for double mastectomies. They were in and out of mental health facilities, constantly trying new drugs, and they never, ever felt any better. The gender clinics that claimed they wanted to provide treatment for children, were stringing them down a pathy of mental and physical deterioration.

* * *
* * *
The medical industry has destroyed its credibility. The report on manipulative gender ideology comes hot off the heels of Dr. Anthony Fauci refusing to answer for the lies he told during the Covid pandemic. In his diaries, Fauci frequently contradicted his public and private beliefs.
His writings expose his lies over the lab-leak theory, the efficacy of vaccines, and the consequences of booster shots. In texts from his government-issued phone, Fauci **[admitted](https://substack.com/redirect/6cabea3f-8b62-44ed-aa35-a20d7e820108?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that Covid vaccines could "theoretically" be "associated with miscarriage." For many children and young adults, Covid was a pivotal moment, one that permanently changed their lives. Fauci is further proof that the modern medical industry has consistently worked against Americans.
HHS's report asks that a number of medical organizations be **[investigated](https://substack.com/redirect/cf31fa03-6839-4739-b24f-330d4c19f48b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by the Department of Justice for potentially violating federal law by defrauding Medicaid. However, no amount of prosecutions will ever undo the damage done to thousands and thousands of young people.
The institutions who coaxed young people into cutting off healthy body parts and committing themselves to hospitals violated their oath to do no harm. They didn't see ideologically confused kids as patients but as customers. My friend who changed her name and has committed to a lifetime of cross sex hormones is a victim of predatory medical malpractice.

They’re calling in favors from their billionaire pals in West Hollywood and New York to dump a tidal wave of out-of-state cash into Georgia. **They want to keep Ossoff in office so he can keep doing what he’s been doing:** **> > Voting against border security** while I had to write and pass the Laken Riley Act just to get federal law enforcement to hold illegal alien criminals. **> > Pushing taxpayer-funded benefits like Medicaid for illegal immigrants** while hard-working Georgians get crushed by inflation. **> > Rubber-stamping liberal, activist judges** who spend their days trying to block the America First agenda from the bench. **> > Supporting schemes to pack the Supreme Court** and scrap the Senate filibuster so they can pass their radical agenda with zero opposition. **If Chuck Schumer and the Left seize control of the Senate, it won’t just hurt Georgia – it will ruin the entire country.** They’ll dismantle the filibuster and strip away your rights before you can even catch your breath.

Right now, this Georgia Senate race is in an absolute dead heat. Neck-and-neck. A complete dogfight. The Left knows if we flip this seat, their whole radical circus in Washington comes screeching to a halt. The experts are all saying the exact same thing: The Senate majority depends on what we do right here in Georgia over the next 3 months. We can win this thing, but with out-of-state billionaires dumping millions to stop us, I need you to step up right now. Jon Ossoff and his liberal buddies in DC are looking at the polls, seeing us tied up, and absolutely losing their minds. They’re calling in favors from their billionaire pals in West Hollywood and New York to dump a tidal wave of out-of-state cash into Georgia. If Chuck Schumer and the Left seize control of the Senate, it won’t just hurt Georgia – it will ruin the entire country. A new report found that _more than a third_ of all U.S. counties are considered maternity care deserts — meaning for too many women, there are no hospitals, birthing centers, or obstetrics clinics where they live.

But that’s not all. More than half of all U.S. counties don't have a hospital with labor and delivery services, and nearly 70% of those maternity care deserts are in rural counties — forcing individuals to drive burdensome long distances to access care.

**Women’s reproductive health care has been under constant attack over the last decade, drastically increasing the number of care deserts.** When _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, red states passed abortion bans and laws that criminalized providers and patients, and OBGYNs everywhere have had to make difficult choices. Case in point: In Idaho, more than a third of OBGYNs have left the state since Roe was overturned.

_And then you have the federal government with Donald Trump and Republicans at the helm. _

→ They’ve defunded Planned Parenthood and abortion providers, which has caused dozens of health care clinics across the country to close.

→ They cut health care funding, which has led to more Americans going uninsured and small rural hospitals having to shut their doors.

→ Now, maternal and infant mortality are on the rise. And the richest country in the world is telling pregnant people and new mothers: you're on your own.

I call bullsh*t.

_All of this is a direct result of policy choices — and Republicans just keep making it worse._ The Big Ugly Bill signed into law last summer makes drastic cuts to Medicaid and creates new barriers that will push more people off their coverage entirely. But that’s not enough for Republicans. Mike Johnson said _on the record_ a few weeks ago that Republicans plan to make even more cuts to Americans' health care in 2027!

**Trump and Republicans have chosen to let women suffer rather than fund their care. Let’s not give them that choice next year. **
